Execution Progress — feature-acp-bundled-cli-plugins-always-internal (2026-07-14, branch `main`, `/flow:execute`) — **8/8 tasks IMPLEMENTED + live-verified end to end, incl. the native `.app` dogfood; security fan-out complete; NOT committed yet.** Plan `.ai/plans/feature-acp-bundled-cli-plugins-always-internal.md`; DDR-168 (renumbered from the plan's placeholder DDR-167 — that number was claimed by a concurrent session's `local-file-svg-pdf-ingestion-security-posture` DDR before this session started).

Flips two prior "respect disk state" gates so Maude Desktop's ACP chat panel always uses the app's own bundled `maude` CLI + `design`/`flow` plugins: `sidecar.rs` PATH prepend (was append, DDR-166 T0b) + `plugin-bootstrap.ts` unconditional injection (was scan-gated no-op, DDR-143 Decision 3) + `bridge.ts`'s new `options.settings.enabledPlugins['design@maude']=false` structural double-registration guard + `readiness.ts` copy pass + DDR-143/DDR-166 supersession pointers + a `CLAUDE.md` `MAUDE_NO_PLUGIN_BOOTSTRAP=1` dogfooding note. `cargo check` + full `apps/studio` `bun test` (2546 pass/5 skip/1 pre-existing unrelated flake, confirmed clean in isolation) + biome/tsc on touched files all clean. **Security fan-out CLOSED, 2 rounds:** `security-auditor` (gate MET, 0 blockers first pass) + `ethical-hacker` (round 1: 2 blockers — TOCTOU in `stage_bundled_cli_link()`'s non-atomic symlink swap, fixed with temp-name+rename; alias-mismatch gap in the `enabledPlugins` guard, investigated and confirmed to be a **pre-existing** `scanPlugins()` limitation since DDR-143, not a new regression, documented as a named residual in DDR-168 rather than code-fixed). Round 2: **verdict "sound to proceed", 0 blockers** — independently re-verified both dispositions; surfaced one non-blocking follow-up (the `enabledPlugins` literal doesn't auto-extend if `flow@maude` injection is re-enabled later — currently unreachable) closed with an inline landmine comment in `bridge.ts`.

**Native dogfood, done live, no fabricated confidence — both halves actually exercised (owner asked "how do we know this really works" and got an honest, evidence-based answer):** (1) **Plugin-injection precedence** — tested against the real installed, signed-in `claude` 2.1.207 CLI (no Tauri build needed): a sandboxed `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` fixture with a genuinely `✔ enabled` local marketplace copy of `design@maude` (confirmed via `claude plugin list`, not just a hand-written registry file), carrying a unique marker command; read the raw `stream-json` `system:init` `slash_commands` array (pre-UI-dedup) across 3 runs. Result: bundled copy always wins content-wise, zero duplicate commands, zero duplicate `SessionStart` hook firing — **identically whether the `enabledPlugins:false` override is present or absent**. This downgraded the DDR's own causal story: Claude Code's own `--plugin-dir` precedence, not our override, is what's actually preventing double-registration — documented as a correction in DDR-168 (override kept as harmless defense-in-depth, not removed). (2) **PATH precedence** — required a real built `.app` (`stage_bundled_cli_link()` never engages under `tauri dev`); built the debug bundle, launched it directly with `SHELL` pointed at a throwaway script producing a fully controlled fake login-shell PATH containing a decoy `maude`, captured the sidecar's actual constructed PATH string via a temporary (since-reverted) `eprintln!`, and confirmed via a real `command -v maude` shell resolution that the bundled symlink wins over the decoy. Hit one unrelated pre-existing bug along the way (`css-tree`/svgo data-file bundling crash in the compiled `maude-server` binary, orthogonal to this diff's 4 files — flagged in DDR-168, not fixed here, worth its own follow-up). All verification artifacts (temp fixtures, debug print) cleaned up / reverted before finishing; `cargo check` re-confirmed clean after the revert.

decision.title: Execution Progress — feature-onboarding-and-design-system-migration T9 (2026-07-14, branch `main`, `/flow:execute`) — DDR-167 (local-file/SVG/PDF ingestion secu
decision.rationale:
Execution Progress — feature-onboarding-and-design-system-migration T9 (2026-07-14, branch `main`, `/flow:execute`) — **DDR-167 (local-file/SVG/PDF ingestion security posture) RECORDED, 2 full rounds of design-stage security review, Accepted. Committed as part of this DDR-only change; gates all of Phase 3 (T10–T13).** Plan `.ai/plans/feature-onboarding-and-design-system-migration.md`.

Per the plan's explicit "record the DDR FIRST, reviewed before any code" gate — no Phase 3 implementation exists yet, this is design-stage only. Drafted DDR-167 covering: SVG (allowlist DOM-sanitize via `happy-dom`, already a dependency, no new dep) and PDF (rasterize via the already-bundled headless Chromium, `pdf-lib` for page-count only, no new dep — explicitly rejects `pdfjs-dist`+native-canvas as the same `bun --compile`-hostile class the Task-2.7 whisper spike hit) ingestion, write-path containment mirroring `_fetch-asset.mjs`, and a new privileged `POST /_api/import-asset` route.

**Round 1** (`ethical-hacker` + `security-auditor`, parallel, against the initial draft) surfaced real, substantive gaps — not nitpicks: (1) HIGH — the original draft's PDF-safety claim ("never parsed by a PDF-content-executing library") was flatly wrong; Chromium's PDFium auto-fires embedded JS/`OpenAction` with no user interaction and carries an active CVE cadence — revised around genuine process isolation (hard network-deny, OS sandbox on, binary-freshness, mandatory adversarial pre-ship fixtures) instead. (2) HIGH — pairing `happy-dom` as a sanitizer with a later re-parse elsewhere is a documented mutation-XSS anti-pattern (DOMPurify maintainers' own explicit warning); flipped Decision 1 from a denylist to an allowlist and added a real-browser execution canary as the final oracle rather than trusting `happy-dom` alone. (3) HIGH — confused-deputy: the "operator-trusted CLI path" framing missed that this repo's own ACP chat panel can invoke the CLI verb via an auto-approved Bash tool call (DDR-125 §F2). (4) A T12-scope-boundary finding: the *next* task's hand-off of extracted content to `ux-research-agent` is the actual trifecta-completing step and had no DDR gate at all. Plus: XML processing instructions, CSS `@import`/legacy-execution properties, a missing `pdf-lib` timeout, and a factually-wrong multipart-body claim (this dev server has zero multipart parsing anywhere).

**Round 2** (confirmation pass, not fresh discovery) found 3 of 5 fully resolved on the first revision but caught genuine remaining gaps worth a second pass: the `href`-style external-reference restriction hadn't been extended to `fill`/`clip-path`/`mask`/`filter`/`marker-*` (same `url(...)` FuncIRI syntax); the `pdf-lib` timeout was specified as a bare `Promise.race`, which cannot interrupt a synchronous CPU-bound hang on Bun's single-threaded runtime (would freeze the whole dev-server, not just reject the request) — needs real `worker_threads` isolation with `.terminate()`; a newly-allowlisted SMIL element set (`animate`/`set`) opened a real, actively-exploited href-retargeting bypass class (CVE-2025-66412, CVE-2025-68461) that the revision hadn't flagged; and the "not fully closeable" framing on the confused-deputy finding was too pessimistic for a brand-new, purpose-built tool — replaced with a concrete technical gate (an ACP-session-scoped proof-token requirement, carefully bounded so it never touches the legitimate plain-terminal power-user path).

**Final DDR-167 shape:** every finding across both rounds now has either a concrete technical closure specified in the doc, or is named as an explicit, bounded, accepted residual matching this project's own house style (DDR-164 §F3/F4) — nothing left as vague reassurance. Two genuinely novel, permanently-required mechanisms fall out of this review that T10 must build exactly as specified: (1) a shared, hardened "sandboxed-render" browser helper (network-deny verified against IP-literal targets not just hostnames, sandbox never disabled, binary-freshness-checked) used by BOTH the PDF rasterizer and a new SVG execution canary; (2) the ACP-session-scoped proof-token gate for the CLI verb. Three permanent regression-test requirements (PDF adversarial fixtures, the SVG canary, a grep-based "no `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` sourced from an imported SVG" test) — not one-time pre-ship checks. Also added plan task **T12a** (a follow-up DDR gating T12's content hand-off to `ux-research-agent`, mirroring T9/T14's own pattern) since Round 1 found the plan itself didn't enforce the scope boundary DDR-167 draws around its own coverage.

**Not yet started:** Phase 3 code (T10–T13) — this session recorded and hardened the gate, no implementation. DDR-167 + the plan's T12a addition + the DDR README index entry are the only changes this task made.

Execution Progress — feature-onboarding-and-design-system-migration Phase 2 (2026-07-14, branch `main`, `/flow:execute`) — **T6/T7/T8 IMPLEMENTED + live-verified. Committed `1e82fb80`, not pushed.** Plan `.ai/plans/feature-onboarding-and-design-system-migration.md`.

Guided quick-setup onboarding path, on top of Phase 0 (committed `b94c079f`) + Phase 1 (committed via `742e5367`/`adb85f41`/`8e66c06c`/`377587f7`).

- **T6** — `apps/studio/design-setup-readiness.ts` (`probeSetupReadiness(ctx)`, pure/read-only, mirrors `readiness.ts`'s shape): 4-item envelope — project (`.design/config.json` genuinely on disk vs the Rust `write_minimal_design()` empty scaffold) / design system (declared AND its tokens CSS actually exists on disk, not just declared) / first canvas (any `.tsx`/`.html` under a NON-`system` canvas group — a DS specimen never counts) / brand assets (a DDR-141 `preview/logo.*` specimen). Wired as `GET /_api/setup-readiness` in `http.ts` (same `sameOriginWrite` + `isLoopbackHost` double gate as `/_api/preflight`; MAIN-ORIGIN ONLY — added to the `canvas-origin-gate.test.ts` 403 list). Unit tests: `test/design-setup-readiness.test.ts` (5/5 — bare scaffold, real-config-no-DS, declared-but-missing-tokens, all-present→ready, system-group-never-counts-as-first-canvas).
- **T7** — `apps/studio/client/tour/quick-setup-tour.js` (`QUICK_SETUP_TOUR`, 5 steps: centered overview → sidebar → Assistant toggle ("ask it to build your design system — no terminal") → viewport → centered close-out) on the existing `TourOverlay` engine, no fork. `apps/studio/client/panels/SetupChecklist.jsx` (`useSetupReadiness()` hook + `SetupChecklist` list + `SetupChecklistDialog`, mirrors `ReadinessList.jsx`/`ReadinessDialog`'s shape exactly, reused `.help-modal` chrome). Reachable from Help ▸ "Quick setup" (native-only, alongside the other two tours) and a persistent `data-testid="st-empty-start-quick-setup"` button in the empty-canvas state — gated on `!setupReadiness.ready` so it auto-hides once the project has all four (this repo's own dogfood project already does, confirmed live). `test/tour-overlay.test.tsx` extended with a `QUICK_SETUP_TOUR` shape + render assertion (6/6 total).
- **T8** — "Bring my existing brand" lives inside the checklist (`data-testid="onboarding-bring-brand"`), links to `https://maude.sh/docs/getting-started` (same `learnMore` URL pattern `whats-new.json` already uses — P3's real in-app ingestion panel doesn't exist yet, so this is the documented stub the plan calls for). Not added to the pre-project `OnboardingWizard.jsx` Welcome door — that screen has no project open yet, so a project-scoped readiness probe has nothing to probe; scoped instead to the post-project checklist, which is the natural place it becomes meaningful.

**Found + fixed while screenshot-verifying (not caught by unit tests or tsc):** the new `.setup-cl-tx` flex-column CSS lived in `client/styles/6-acp-chat.css`/`3-shell-maude.css` but `dist/styles.css` is a committed, separately-built artifact — a bare dev-server boot self-heals `client.bundle.js` but NOT `styles.css`, so the checklist rendered with label+detail running together on one line ("Project set up"maude" — a real...") until `MAUDE_SKIP_RUNTIME_BUILD=1 bun run build.ts --release` was run. Caught via a live screenshot (per the standing house rule to verify UI changes in a browser, not just unit tests), not by any automated gate — worth remembering for future style-only edits.

**Live-verified** (agent-browser against a throwaway `--port 4711` server instance on this repo, killed after; the shared port-4407 server from a concurrent session was left untouched): (a) web/non-native — `st-empty` correctly omits the quick-setup button and the Help menu correctly omits "Quick setup"/"How sharing works"/"Check AI editing readiness" (native-gated); (b) native (simulated via `agent-browser open --init-script` stubbing `window.__TAURI__.core.invoke`/`event.listen`) — Help ▸ Quick setup opens the dialog showing all 4 items present (this repo's real dogfood state) + working Start-guided-setup/Bring-my-brand/Re-check actions; walked the tour steps 1–3 live (centered overview → sidebar spotlight → Assistant-toggle spotlight, all correctly resolving real DOM targets).

**Gate:** `bun test test/design-setup-readiness.test.ts test/tour-overlay.test.tsx test/canvas-origin-gate.test.ts` — 12/12 pass. `bunx tsc --noEmit`: same 12 pre-existing DDR-026-baseline errors, 0 new (none in touched files). `biome check --write`: clean (2 pre-existing-style warnings, non-blocking, consistent with codebase convention elsewhere). Client bundle + styles rebuilt release-minified. **Shared-tree note:** the working tree also carries a concurrent session's small, pure-reformatting (biome/prettier, zero semantic diff) pass over `http.ts`/`readiness.ts`/`acp/login-state.ts` plus its own in-flight files (`ui-prefs.ts`, `cli/bin/maude.mjs`, `apps/desktop/scripts/build-cli-binary.mjs`, `apps/desktop/e2e/scenarios/acp-cold-start.e2e.ts`, `apps/studio/test/fixtures/fake-claude-auth.mjs`, several `site/` docs/catalog files) — none of those were touched by this pass; only this phase's own files are staged-candidate. Not committed yet — awaiting user go-ahead. Remaining plan scope: Phase 3 (T9 ingestion-security DDR + T10–T13 deterministic migration ingestion) and Phase 4 (T14–T15, experimental vision reconstruction) not started.

decision.rationale:
Execution Progress — feature-onboarding-and-design-system-migration Phase 1, pivot (2026-07-13, branch `main`, `/flow:execute`) — **owner redirected mid-phase: "how to" reference canvases seeded into every new project, replacing further explainer-video work as the Phase 1 deliverable.** NOT committed yet.

After the video-surfacing work below shipped, the owner reviewed it and asked to pivot: rather than sink more effort into video content, every NEW project should be seeded with two rich, multi-artboard reference canvases explaining Maude's own capabilities — sourced from a changelog sweep (`whats-new.json`, ~60 entries) rather than guessed.

**Built:** `scaffold-design.ts` (the single source every "New project"/"Set up Maude here" flow calls) now seeds THREE canvases, not one — `Welcome.tsx` (unchanged) + two new ones, embedded as escaped template-literal constants (source of truth: `.design/ui/How to use Maude.tsx` + `How to make video.tsx` in this repo, re-synced by hand): **"How to use Maude"** (10 artboards — start here, design system, editing, AI Assistant, point/comment/draw iteration, AI image generation, photo editing, media & templates, save/share/collaborate, draw-as-code) and **"How to make video"** (7 artboards — start a comp, Timeline, AI Assistant for video, footage-into-a-cut, AI video/audio generation, captions, export).

**Two real bugs found and fixed while verifying, both would have shipped broken to every future new project:** (1) the canvases originally imported `system/maude/colors_and_type.css` + `preview/_components.css` for their tokens — which don't exist on a genuinely fresh project (`system/` is empty until `/design:setup-ds` runs), so every `var(--token)` would have resolved to nothing on a real new project despite rendering perfectly in this repo's own dogfood DS. Fixed by inlining the token values as custom properties on the root wrapper, and replacing the two `.chip`/`.btn` DS-class dependencies with self-contained styled components — now genuinely zero-dependency. (2) a flex-basis competition collapsed an illustrative mockup panel to 2px width in one artboard (a second, structurally-identical artboard "worked" only by flex-arithmetic coincidence) — both fixed with an explicit width. Caught by live-rendering every artboard (not just eyeballing the JSX), including a full end-to-end test: scaffolded a genuinely fresh, isolated temp project (not this repo) and served it standalone, confirming all three canvases compile and render with zero other files present.

**New regression test** `test/scaffold-design.test.ts` (6 cases) exercises the real `scaffoldDesign()` against a real temp dir — asserts file presence, non-trivial size (would catch a silent template-escaping truncation), TSX parse-validity via `Bun.Transpiler`, meta.json shape, and explicitly asserts no `system/maude/` import regressions. Verify: `apps/studio` full suite 2492 pass / 2 fail (same 2 pre-existing unrelated flakes as before, confirmed in isolation).

**Open question for the owner:** the video-surfacing work from earlier this session (below) — `/_media/` route, Help-menu "Watch the intro" + `IntroVideoDialog`, the onboarding-wizard button, the `Maude Explainer.tsx` canvas, the What's New entry — is it being kept alongside the new canvas-seeding work, or superseded/removed? decision.rationale: Execution Progress — feature-bulk-media-insert (2026-07-11, branch `main`) — **13/13 tasks IMPLEMENTED via /flow:execute, verified live, not yet committed.** Plan `.ai/plans/feature-bulk-media-insert.md`. Part A (bug fix, Tasks 1-5) — the batch-drop data-loss race in `annotations-layer.tsx`. Task 1 (functional-updater optimistic insert) + Task 2 (new `media-commit-chain.ts` — a Promise-chained accumulator, not a bare `strokesRef.current` re-read) fixed the reported "1 shown, sometimes 2, sometimes N" bug. **Live-testing against a real dev server caught a SECOND, tighter race**: the chain's idle-reset cleared in a couple of microtask ticks, faster than React's actual render catch-up, so a fast-resolving link could still hand the next one a stale snapshot. Fixed by having idle reads reconcile against `remembered` (the chain's own last output, id-keyed) instead of trusting a bare fresh read — this is the one deviation from the plan's literal "idle-reset to strokesRef.current" wording, recorded because it's exactly the kind of thing a DDR should capture. Verified: 9/9 live runs (batch sizes 2/5/8 × 3 repeats) — 0 loss, 50 distinct stroke ids in valid XML — plus 6 new deterministic unit tests in `test/media-commit-chain.test.ts` (tick-based interleaving, no real timers, so not flaky). Part B (feature, Tasks 6-13) — generalized `AssetPicker` (`client/app.jsx`) into a bulk insert tool: `multiple` prop (checkbox-select grid, `.st-ap-check` badge), destination toggle (Add to artboard / Add as annotation, auto-disables + auto-switches when no artboard anchor or a non-image is selected), multi-file upload (web `input.multiple` + new native `pick_media_files` Tauri command mirroring `pick_media_file`). Tool-palette + context-menu "Insert Image" now always opens the picker in `multiple` mode, and an artboard-less canvas no longer no-ops (opens picker, annotation-only). New batched `insert-annotation-media` message + `createMediaFromAssetPaths` handler in `annotations-layer.tsx` resolves every image's natural size via `Promise.all` before ONE `commitStrokes` — correct by construction, no chain needed (all inputs already resolved). **Live-verified end-to-end (agent-browser, isolated throwaway `.design/` scratch projects + isolated `--session` — never touched the shared live dev server on port 4555 that a concurrent session has open):** (a) with-artboard canvas, 3-image multi-select, "Add to artboard" default → 3 real `` landed in the artboard source; (b) same canvas, 2 images + 1 video → "Add to artboard" correctly disabled with a visible reason, switched to annotation → exactly 3 strokes (2 image + 1 mediaref) in one atomic commit; (c) artboard-less canvas → picker opens (previously a silent no-op), only "Add as annotation" available. Screenshot confirms checkmarks/count/toggle/note all render correctly. **Gate:** `bun test` 94/94 pass on every touched file (media-commit-chain, annotations-layer, canvas-media-drop); a full-suite run showed unrelated server-boot-timeout flakes (photo-edit-api, acp-bridge, exporters/jobs — different files each run) traced to shared-machine load (uptime showed load avg ~64) and confirmed NOT caused by this change (manually booted the server standalone — starts fine, just past the test harness's fixed 3 s budget under load). `bunx tsc --noEmit` + `biome check`: 0 new errors on any touched file (biome's `apps/studio/client/**` exclusion means app.jsx/github.js aren't linted by design). Rust `pick_media_files` command verified against the vendored `tauri-plugin-dialog` 2.7.1 source (no local `cargo` to compile) — mirrors the proven `pick_media_file` pattern exactly (3-file wiring: `generate_handler!` + capabilities `allow-pick-media-files` + `build.rs` `commands()`); real desktop-build verification still needed (Task 8's own deferred note) — **user dogfood item**. Client bundle rebuilt release-minified (`MAUDE_SKIP_RUNTIME_BUILD=1 bun run build.ts --release`) to capture the app.jsx/CSS changes; the source-server boots done for testing had regenerated an unminified dev `client.bundle.js` — restored to the ~1.76 MB release artifact, `comment-mount.js` reverted to HEAD (no unrelated churn). NOTE: `dist/client.bundle.js`/`dist/styles.css` also reflect the OTHER concurrent session's uncommitted `client/` edits (feature-ai-media-generation / fix-photo-editor-followup-debt) since the bundle is a function of the whole tree — commit-scoping this needs a decision at commit time, flagged to the user. Not committed yet — awaiting user go-ahead per `/flow:execute`'s standard post-execution flow. One DDR-worthy item deferred to `/flow:done`: the commit-chain-with-accumulator pattern + the batched `insert-annotation-media` protocol (precedent: DDR-148/150/152 on the same media-intake surface).

decision.rationale:
Execution Progress — fix-photo-editor-followup-debt (2026-07-11, branch `main`) — **CLOSED via /flow:done.** 24/24 tasks committed (`bcc08bca`, not pushed) and archived (`.ai/plans/archive/fix-photo-editor-followup-debt.md`). Fixes all 15 blockers found at feature-photo-editor's `/flow:done` retroactive fan-out (2026-07-10) — 6 security (Stage A, `photo-bg-remove.sh`), 1 CSP exception (Stage B), 1 canvas-lib hardening (Stage C), 5 design-system (Stage D, `PhotoKnobs`), 6 a11y (Stage E), 2 regression tests + re-audit + DDR (Stage F).

**`/flow:done` re-confirmation (2026-07-11):** static gates green for this plan's own files (whole-repo `pnpm lint` + site `build` gates have pre-existing failures attributable entirely to the concurrent feature-ai-media-generation session's own uncommitted work — confirmed via `git log`/`git show`, not this plan's files); `pnpm test` + `pnpm test:dev-server` green modulo 4 known order-dependent flaky tests (pass cleanly in isolation, unrelated to this plan); `parity`/`tarball`/`tokens` custom gates green. Step-4 fan-out re-spawned scoped strictly to commit `bcc08bca`: `design-system-guard` 0 blockers, `a11y-auditor` 0 blockers, `security-auditor` 0 blockers (independently verified the `$SESSION` fix landed correctly in the committed code), `ethical-hacker` 0 blockers (additional bypass attempts against the `--asset` regex — all rejected). `scenario-runner` was spawned but not waited out to completion — user asked to close the plan given the overwhelming confirmatory signal from the other four; equivalent live coverage already obtained twice over (`/execute`'s own re-audit + this pass). No changeset added for this release (soft gate, overridable) — recommend one before the next release given the security content. Not pushed.

- **Stage A** (`apps/studio/bin/photo-bg-remove.sh`) — strict `assets/[0-9a-f]{8,64}\.ext` regex replaces the old prefix-only glob (closes the chained JSX-injection exploit); symlink-safe harness write (O_EXCL tmp + atomic `mv`, mirrors `sync/atomic-write.ts`); stdout deliverable shape-validated; `--slug` hard-fails instead of downgrading; harness scratch cleaned up on success only; `mkdir`-based per-asset concurrency lock. All 6 manually live-tested against a real symlink-decoy / injection-string / lock-contention / slug.sh-removed reproduction — each closes exactly as designed.
- **Stage B** (`apps/studio/http.ts`) — `connect-src 'self' https://staticimgly.com`, documented as the ONE exception (IMG.LY's background-removal model-weight CDN), DDR-recorded (below).
- **Stage C** (`apps/studio/canvas-lib.tsx`) — `PhotoPreviewBridge`'s `photo-busy` handler now requires `ASSET_REF_RE.test(m.asset)`, closing the empty-string-matches-every-photo gap.
- **Stage D/E** (`apps/studio/client/photo-knobs.jsx` + `app.jsx`'s `ColorPicker`) — `Slider` reimplemented as a bordered drag-scrub field reusing `.st-cp-num`/`.st-cp-numin.st-cp-scrub`/`.st-cp-step` (mirrors CssKnobs' `num()`); Remove Background button → `StIcon` sparkle + `.st-btn`; off-ladder values snapped to `var(--space-*)`/`var(--radius-*)`/`var(--tracking-wide)`; double padding on the tab root removed; three `<select>`s → `.st-cp-nsel` + `aria-label`; two `--fg-3` texts bumped to `--fg-2` (≥4.5:1 both themes); context-menu focus-visible ring restored (`--maude-hud-accent`, was `outline:none`); `ColorPicker` gained an optional `label` prop (distinct Shadow/Highlight/Pattern-color announcements) + arrow-key operability on the SV pad/hue bar; `aria-busy`+`sr-only aria-live` region on the bg-removal busy state; Section titles → real `<h3>`.
- **Stage F** — new `test/photo-bg-remove-validation.test.ts` (6 cases: traversal/injection/backtick/uppercase-hex/bare-prefix/happy-path) + extended `test/csp-canvas-shell.test.ts` (exact `connect-src` match, both directions of drift). DDR-161 addendum (2026-07-11) records the `connect-src` decision.

**Re-audit gate (Task 23) — a real regression found and fixed mid-review.** `design-system-guard` re-audit: **0 blockers**, all 5 confirmed fixed (1 non-blocking hygiene advisory: a few pre-existing off-ladder `fontSize`/`gap` values not in Task 11's scope, pixel-identical either way). `a11y-auditor` re-audit initially found **1 blocker**: the Slider refactor's `onCommit` callbacks were all zero-arg arrows that discarded the value passed and re-read a stale render-closure — so typing a value or clicking the stepper buttons silently no-op'd (only pointer-drag worked, since `onChange` pre-wrote state before `onCommit` fired). A genuine WCAG 2.1.1 keyboard-operability regression from this session's own Task 9 refactor, not a pre-existing issue. Fixed all 7 call sites (Adjustments + Duotone/Grain/Pattern/Mask sliders) to use their argument; re-verified live by the same agent — 8/8 a11y items now pass.

**Security fan-out (mandatory, closes the "shipped unreviewed" gap the follow-up-debt plan exists because of):** `security-auditor` + `ethical-hacker` both independently reviewed the diff — **0 blockers** from both. Both independently found the same 1 low-severity bug: `cleanup()`'s `EXIT` trap referenced `$SESSION` before it was assigned, so under `set -uo pipefail` the harness-write failure paths aborted mid-cleanup on the unbound variable, leaking the lock dir (self-DoS, not externally exploitable). Fixed by moving the `SESSION=` assignment before `trap cleanup EXIT` is installed (verified via a minimal repro reproducing both the bug and the fix). Full studio suite green (2297 pass, only the pre-existing flaky `exporters/jobs` timing tests fail); tsc/biome clean on the changed files. **Backbone (Stages A–C, G-parametric, H) already landed on `main` earlier (5 commits, DDR-161).** Round 1 (below) resumed the cluster the owner HELD "for a live-browser pass" — the Inspector Photo tab + PhotoKnobs mount + selection threading + context menus + the live-preview compositor bridge — and drove it to **live-verified done via agent-browser** against this repo's own `.design/` (booted same-origin, `MAUDE_CANVAS_ORIGIN_SPLIT=0`, on `Smoke TSX`'s ``). - **✅ Task 14** — `Selection.photoKind`/`photoAsset` + shared `photoAssetFromString` (use-selection-set.tsx); `open-inspector` honors a `tab` arg). - **✅ Task 15** — `PhotoKnobs` MOUNTED (ColorPicker injected; `onPhotoEdit` down-channel = `postToActiveCanvas({dgn:'photo-preview'})`; `onPhotoRemoveBackground`; shell-side photo-undo stack). **Cmd+Z on photo edits = remaining polish.** - **✅ Task 4/6/12-preview** — `PhotoPreviewBridge` in canvas-lib (mounted in canvas-shell's chrome layer): consumes `dgn:'photo-preview'`, overlays a real `` pixi composite over the matching ``/`` at its live screen rect (rAF-tracked, world-size pixi + CSS scale so zoom never rebuilds the Application), removes on neutral. - **✅ Task 16** — `MenuItem.hidden?` predicate (context-menu.tsx, render-time filtered) + "Edit Photo…" in canvas-shell's element registry (content-addressed-`` only). - **◐ Task 17** — annotation `AnnotationContextMenu` "Edit Photo…" (`canEditPhoto`, tool==='image', mirrors the F3 replace-request pattern) — CODE DONE, live-verify deferred (test canvas has no annotation photo). - **◐ Task 12** — ML Remove-Background CODE wired (lazy `import('@imgly/background-removal')`, client-side matte → `/_api/asset` → `PhotoEdit.backgroundRemoved`). Ops gotcha learned: ALWAYS `pkill -f 'maude-server --root .*e2e/fixtures'` between runs — a leaked sidecar from a force-killed run serves stale staged sources (caused one 3-fail flake + one boot-timeout). Staged-resource shortcut: canvas-runtime source edits can be `cp`-synced into `Maude.app/Contents/Resources/apps/studio/` instead of a full tauri rebuild (runtime Bun.build reads them from disk). - [x] Phase 2 — Task 2.1: editors off `` → plain HTML portaled into the world div. New `AnnotEditors` component renders beside (not inside) the `.dc-annot-svg` portal — overlay now returns TWO portals into worldRef; each editor's old foreignObject x/y/w/h became host-div left/top/width/height verbatim (world coords map 1:1 under the transform); `[data-annot-editor]` host attr; `.dc-annot-editor` was ALREADY in CHROME_SELECTOR so doc-capture handlers skip in-editor clicks; StandaloneTextEditor host is pointer-events:none with the editable re-enabling auto (outside-click commit preserved); section-title 1/zoom counter-scaling carried over unchanged (it's world-unit math, host-agnostic). Shared `placeCaretAt(editable, win, point?, fallbackToSelectAll)` exported from `text-caret.ts` (caretRangeFromPoint → caretPositionFromPoint → outside-editable guard → select-all fallback); `canvas-shell.tsx` `enterEditModeAt` refactored onto it (one chain, can't diverge). New `useEditorCaret(ref, caretPoint)` hook wired into TextEditor/StickyEditor/StandaloneTextEditor (+ SectionTitleEditor via pass-through): mount = focus + place-at-entry-click + mountCaret; in-editor plain clicks re-place the caret on POINTERUP (not pointerdown — preserves native drag-select + shift-click; synthetic/untrusted events get no UA caret action, so the app path is what the harness asserts). Entry coords: `editCaretPoint` state set ONLY by the dblclick handler (keyboard entries — Enter, fresh-create, ⌘Enter chain — stay select-all, the rename convention), cleared in commit/cancel. Two hard-won harness fixes: (1) `_canvas-state/.view.json` camera PERSISTS across runs (DDR-115) → a previous run's pan/zoom left targets off-viewport where caretRangeFromPoint resolves null → suite now deletes `_canvas-state` in before() + fits + waits for rect-stable; (2) WKWebView PAUSES rAF for occluded windows → the custom caret was mounted-but-invisible → text-caret.ts now positions synchronously on mount + on selectionchange/input/keyup/focus/blur/scroll, with rAF only as the pan/zoom tracker. e2e: 5 passing (sticky offset-accurate caret ±3 chars, second click moves caret, custom caret mounted on annotation editors). - [x] Phase 4 — Task 4.1: Text tool click-through. KEY DEVIATION from the plan: the annotation-stroke hit-test is GEOMETRIC (`findTextStrokeAt` — world-coord bbox walk, topmost/last-rendered first), NOT `elementsFromPoint` — while a draw tool is armed every stroke node renders `pointerEvents="none"` (hitMode), making DOM hit-testing structurally blind to them (measured in WKWebView: the click fell through and created a new text over the sticky). Precedence = z-order: strokes (paint above) → artboard leaf-text (`findEditableElementAt` restored, delegates via maude:enter-text-edit) → empty space = new pending text. Fixture gained seeded section `s_e2esection1` (serializer-format `` + chip text). Since commit tests write through to disk (annotations PUT + /_api/edit-text), the suite snapshots both fixture files in before() and restores byte-exact in after() — verified clean post-run. Selector gotcha: the LIVE sticky read body is `.dc-sticky-body` (class), the `[data-sticky-body]` attr exists only in the persisted SVG — the P2 ghost-check was silently vacuous until fixed. e2e: 7 passing. - [x] Phase 6 — Task 6.1 (`canvas-pipeline.ts` stamps `data-cd-editable="text"` during the data-cd-id walk via `isInlineEditableText` — EXACT mirror of `applyTextEdit`'s acceptance incl. the DDR-150 `{'string literal'}` case; independent of id injection; lockstep-comment on both predicates; new `test/text-editability-stamp.test.ts` incl. a marker⇔engine agreement sweep over every stamped element) + Task 6.2 (canvas-shell dblclick + annotations text-tool click-through both gate on the marker; refused leaf-looking text gets the `showCanvasToast` hint instead of the dead-end editor; deep-select for containers unchanged) + Task 6.3 RUN DOWN: `applyTextEdit` is PROVEN CLEAN — unit sibling-integrity tests + a repro script on the real fixture change exactly 1 line; the baseline's "editing h1 rewrote the p's whitespace" was almost certainly the diagnostic's NATIVE `browser.keys` spillover committing the `

decision.rationale:
Execution Progress — feature-background-export-notification-center (2026-07-08, branch `main`) — DONE via /flow:execute→/flow:done, plan archived, commit `4ff5fd82`

Plan: `.ai/plans/feature-background-export-notification-center.md`. High-complexity: a correctness bug fix (5 Playwright shims) + a new background job queue + a client notification center. All 26 tasks done; plan file's task headings + acceptance criteria checked off inline.

- **Phase A (bug fix + progress instrumentation, Tasks 1–7).** Root cause confirmed: `_png/_pdf/_svg/_html/_pptx-playwright.mjs` each pinned an artboard's `left`/`top` to `0px` for its capture but never restored it, so `canvas-as-separate` (multi-artboard) exports left every earlier artboard stacked at the origin, corrupting every later capture — the reported "scattered/overlapping fragments" bug. Fixed all 5 shims (save-before/restore-after around each per-artboard capture, `pinArtboard()` helper for svg/html). Added `MAUDE_PROGRESS {"current":N,"total":M}` stdout lines per artboard + a new shared `exporters/_runtime.ts` `spawnShim()` (incremental stdout read + `AbortSignal`) threaded through all 6 adapters via a new `ExportHooks` (`onProgress`/`signal`) param on `Adapter.run`/`runExport`.
- **Phase B (background job queue, Tasks 8–14).** New `exporters/jobs.ts`: `createExportJobQueue()` — hand-rolled counting semaphore (`MAUDE_EXPORT_MAX_CONCURRENT`, default 2), in-memory `Map<id,ExportJob>` as the single source of truth for both live `list()` and the derived/capped(20)/overwritten-in-one-shot `_export-history.json` ledger (eliminates the old read-modify-write race), bytes persisted to `<designRoot>/_export-jobs/<id>/`, boot-time ledger reseed + orphan sweep, age/cap eviction. `ExportHistoryEntry`/`loadExportHistory`/`appendExportHistory` moved out of `api.ts` into `jobs.ts`. New `POST /_api/export-jobs` (202 + jobId, non-blocking) + `GET /_api/export-jobs` (list) + `GET /_api/export-jobs/download?id=` — all three confirmed absent from `CANVAS_SAFE_API` + `startCanvasServer` routes (same MAIN-ORIGIN-ONLY class as `/_api/export`, DDR-060). `/_api/export` itself becomes `enqueue()` + `await result` — byte-for-byte contract-unchanged (`/design:export` CLI needs zero changes). `export:job` bus event wired into `ws.ts` (inspector-channel broadcast, mirrors `git-status`). Runtime-state taxonomy (`git/service.ts` `isMaudeRuntimeState`, `cli/lib/gitignore-block.mjs`, root `.gitignore`) all gained `_export-jobs/` together.
- **Phase C (client notification center, Tasks 15–20).** New `client/export-center.jsx` — `useExportCenter()` (hydrate + WS `upsert` + transition-detected toast queue + focus-gated web auto-download / native explicit Save…) + `<ExportBadge>`/`<ExportToast>`/`<ExportPanel>`, structural twin of `whats-new.jsx`. New `.st-exports` menubar CSS (mirrors `.st-assistant`'s `data-busy` pattern) + `.st-export-*` panel/list/progress-bar CSS (new determinate progress bar — no prior art in the client). Both `ExportDialog.doExport()` (main shell) and `export-dialog.tsx`'s `submit()` (in-canvas, cross-origin-bridged) now POST `/_api/export-jobs` and close immediately instead of blocking on `busy`/`submitting`; `runBridgedExport` replies `{ok, jobId}` instead of shipping bytes through the bridge. Rebuilt the committed release bundle (`dist/client.bundle.js` + `dist/styles.css`) per CLAUDE.md's client-surface rule.
- **Bug caught mid-execution (not in the plan):** the first version of `jobs.ts` wrote each completed job's bytes under `<designRoot>/_export-jobs/<id>/`, but `project-raw`'s `RAW_EXCLUDES` walk didn't know about that new directory — every `project-raw` zip export bundled all *prior* export outputs (including prior zips, which already contained their own priors), causing genuine exponential blowup: 25 sequential `project-raw` exports went 28ms → 4.7s → timeout. Root-caused via a manual timing repro (not just "tests are slow"), fixed by adding `_export-jobs` to `scope.ts`'s `RAW_EXCLUDES` — confirmed flat ~7ms/request after the fix. Would not have been caught by the existing exporter test suite (none of it does a real multi-request `project-raw` sequence).
- **Tests (Tasks 21–23, 25):** `test/exporters/jobs.test.ts` (4 tests — concurrency cap via a real large-sandbox `project-raw` zip timed to ~400ms/job, `list()` sort order, 25-concurrent-completion history race, byte download + eviction), `test/exporters/history.test.ts` extended (20-cap, old-shape-entry back-compat), `test/export-shim-multi-capture.test.ts` (6 tests — static-source regression guard on all 5 shims; a REAL-Chromium execution test is deliberately out of this suite's contract, mirrors `pw-launch.test.ts`'s existing "integration-shape, needs a real browser" precedent — CI has no Chromium installed), `test/export-center.test.tsx` (3 tests — `happy-dom` + real `createRoot`/`act()`, mirrors `canvas-hmr-runtime.test.tsx`; upsert-sequence/runningCount, toast-not-requeued-on-repeat-upsert, focus-gated auto-download via a mocked `fetch`+`document.hasFocus`). `canvas-origin-gate.test.ts` extended with the 2 new routes.
- **Live verification (Task 26) — the literal user repro, against the real `/Users/iagh/git/alligators` 22-artboard canvas** (own local server on a scratch port, not the user's live desktop session on 4400): `canvas-as-separate` PDF export that previously didn't complete in 3+ minutes now finishes in **~10s** with live `"current":N,"total":22` progress; downloaded + decoded the resulting PDF (`pdf-lib`) — 22 pages, correct per-artboard sizes; rendered pages 1/11/22 to PNG (`pdftoppm`) and visually confirmed each shows fully correct, distinct, non-overlapping content (no scatter). Concurrency: fired a slow `canvas-as-separate` PDF + a fast single-artboard PNG back-to-back — PNG reached `done` at t=2s while the PDF was still at `"2 of 22"`, fully independent. UI (via `agent-browser` against the same local server): Export dialog now closes **immediately** on submit (menubar badge count went from 0→1 the instant the dialog closed); toast rendered "EXPORT READY / PNG · Artboard / …png" with Download/Dismiss; Exports panel listed all completed jobs with status pills + per-row Download. In-canvas bridged dialog verified by code symmetry + typecheck only (not live-clicked — same enqueue-and-close path as the main-shell dialog).
- **Gate:** `apps/studio` full suite **2185 pass / 5 skip / 0 fail** (2176 baseline + 9 new). Root CLI suite **178/178**. `bun tsc --noEmit` — same 5 pre-existing DDR-026-baseline errors, 0 new. `pnpm lint` — same pre-existing warnings only (incl. one unrelated `_video-playwright.mjs` comma-operator warning, file untouched by this feature), exit 0. `scripts/check-version-parity.sh` — pass (unaffected files only).
- **Closed via `/flow:done`:** DDR-153 recorded, security fan-out fixes applied (see the **Done 2026-07-08 (background-export-notification-center)** entry above for full detail), committed `4ff5fd82` on `main`, not pushed (owner's call).
- **Concurrency note:** ran on a shared, actively-concurrent `main` — another session landed a real, unrelated jq-escaping security fix to `bin/screenshot.sh` + `bin/_screenshot-playwright.mjs` (uncommitted, on top of its own commit `f8f8bfe9`) while this session worked; diffed and left both files completely untouched, not staged. Also: booting the local dev-server against `/Users/iagh/git/alligators` for live verification (Task 26) clobbered the just-rebuilt release `dist/{client.bundle.js,comment-mount.js}` back to dev-form (the documented CLAUDE.md self-heal gotcha) — caught before commit, rebuilt `--release` a second time; sizes now match the first clean build exactly.
- Files created: `apps/studio/exporters/jobs.ts`, `apps/studio/client/export-center.jsx`, `apps/studio/test/exporters/jobs.test.ts`, `apps/studio/test/export-shim-multi-capture.test.ts`, `apps/studio/test/export-center.test.tsx`. Files modified: 5 shims under `apps/studio/bin/`, `apps/studio/exporters/{index,_runtime,pdf,png,svg,html,pptx,video,scope}.ts`, `apps/studio/{api,http,server,ws,git/service}.ts`, `apps/studio/{export-dialog.tsx,client/app.jsx,client/styles/3-shell-maude.css,client/styles/4-components.css,dist/client.bundle.js,dist/styles.css}`, `apps/studio/test/exporters/history.test.ts`, `apps/studio/test/canvas-origin-gate.test.ts`, `cli/lib/gitignore-block.mjs`, root `.gitignore`. **Uncommitted.**

Plan: `.ai/plans/feature-desktop-intel-mac-support.md`. Low-complexity, CI-config + docs only (no app/runtime code). Executed Task 5 (local repro) FIRST per the plan's own explicit ordering note, since it caught a real bug in the plan's core assumption before any CI edit was made.

- **Task 5 (local repro) — ran first, found + fixed a wrong plan assumption.** `rustup target add x86_64-apple-darwin`, built both dev-server sidecar arches (`bun run build.ts --release --target=bun-darwin-{arm64,x64}`), staged all 4 sidecar files (`sync-sidecar.mjs`/`sync-agent-browser.mjs` × 2 slugs). First `tauri build --target universal-apple-darwin` attempt **FAILED**: `resource path 'binaries/maude-server-universal-apple-darwin' doesn't exist`. Root cause (confirmed via `gh issue view 3355 --repo tauri-apps/tauri`): Tauri's universal-binary auto-lipo only applies to the main Rust binary (cargo compiles both arches itself) — it does **NOT** auto-lipo `externalBin` sidecars; it expects a **pre-built** fat binary literally named `<name>-universal-apple-darwin`. Fixed by running `lipo -create` on both sidecars myself before the build. Second attempt **succeeded**: `Maude_0.40.0_universal.dmg` + `Maude.app` + `Maude.app.tar.gz` all produced (the trailing `TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY` error is expected locally — I don't have that CI secret; unrelated to arch). Verified via `lipo -info` on all 3 shipped binaries (main app `maude-desktop`, `maude-server`, `agent-browser`) — all report `x86_64 arm64`. Live-booted the app from a non-symlinked path on **both** native arm64 and Rosetta-translated x86_64 (`arch -x86_64 ...`) — dev-server sidecar spawned and served `http://localhost:4400` identically on both. Note: the Rosetta run printed Bun's "CPU lacks AVX support" warning — a known Rosetta-2-only limitation (Rosetta doesn't expose AVX/AVX2), not a real-hardware concern since Ventura's minimum-supported Intel Macs (2017+, Kaby Lake+) all have AVX2; not a regression from this plan (same `bun-darwin-x64` target is already used for the CLI's Intel build).
- **Tasks 1–4 (`build-desktop.yml` CI edits)** — applied with the corrected lipo recipe (not the plan's original "auto-lipo" assumption): Rust toolchain step gains a per-leg `matrix.rust_targets` (macOS only, `aarch64-apple-darwin,x86_64-apple-darwin`); sidecar-build step special-cased for macOS to build both arches; the macOS build step now stages all 4 sidecar files THEN runs `lipo -create` to produce `maude-server-universal-apple-darwin` + `agent-browser-universal-apple-darwin` before `tauri build --target universal-apple-darwin`; DMG-notarize glob, matrix `bundle_glob`, and the release-attach globs all repointed at `target/universal-apple-darwin/release/bundle/...`; matrix `label`/`artifact_name` renamed `macos-arm64`→`macos-universal`. Windows/Linux legs untouched (grep-verified: no bare `target/release/bundle` remains on the macOS leg). Header comment block extended to document the lipo-not-auto rationale for future readers.
- **Task 6 (docs)** — fixed the 2 files the plan named (`site/content/docs/desktop/index.mdx`, `download-button.tsx`) **plus 2 more the plan missed** but its own validate grep (`site/app/(home)/desktop`) covers: `site/app/(home)/desktop/page.tsx` had 2 more "Apple Silicon"-only claims (hero fineprint + system-requirements `<dd>`) — fixed all 4 to "Intel or Apple Silicon" / "Intel & Apple Silicon". Grep-verified clean.
- **Drive-by note (not a regression):** `apps/studio/dist/{client.bundle.js,comment-mount.js,styles.css}` were already `M` (dirty) at session start; my required `bun run build.ts --release` invocations (needed to produce the sidecar binaries for Task 5) rebuilt them in release-minified form as a side effect, which happened to exactly match the already-committed HEAD (source hadn't changed) — so they now show clean. Consistent with CLAUDE.md's own documented rule ("rebuild `--release` after any dev-server boot"); nothing lost.
- **Not done (deferred, needs explicit user go-ahead per plan's own Validation §2):** CI dry run via `workflow_dispatch` on a pushed branch, and the post-release updater-feed sanity check — both require pushing/triggering CI, held for the commit/push confirmation step.
- **Gate:** no project-wide lint/typecheck/test/build applies (CI-config + docs only, per CLAUDE.md — this repo has no root test suite). All task-level `Validate:` commands from the plan re-run and passed.
- Files modified: `.github/workflows/build-desktop.yml`, `site/content/docs/desktop/index.mdx`, `site/app/(home)/desktop/download-button.tsx`, `site/app/(home)/desktop/page.tsx`. **Uncommitted.**

Plan: `.ai/plans/feature-element-editing-robustness.md`. ✅ **Stage A — Camera/scroll bug fixes (the two reported bugs) — DONE.** - **Task A1** — replaced the host-scrolling `scrollIntoView({block:'nearest'})` in the `dgn:'select-by-id'` handler (`canvas-shell.tsx`, inside `CanvasRouter`'s onMessage) with a **camera-aware reveal**: new module-level helpers `revealAxisDelta()` (pure minimal 1-axis screen-px delta; 0 when visible or when the element spans the viewport — matches `scrollIntoView` nearest semantics) + `revealElementViaCamera()` (measures live screen boxes, pans via `zoomController.panBy` which reads the exact live vpRef, never host scroll). Both exported for the test. This is the shared root cause of Bugs A + B. - **Task A2** — added a host-scroll-0 invariant clamp: a capture-phase `scroll` listener on the `.dc-canvas` host that resets `scrollLeft/scrollTop` to 0 **only** for engine clip layers (`.dc-canvas` itself, `.dc-artboard-body`, `.dc-artboard`) — author scroll containers deeper in a mock fail the engine-clip test and pass through. `scroll` doesn't bubble, so capture:true lets the host observe a descendant clip's scroll. Enforces the assumption `writeTransform` + `__maudeCanvasRects` both make. - **Task A3** — new `test/camera-reveal.test.tsx` (registers happy-dom like `canvas-hmr-runtime.test.tsx`): 5 `revealAxisDelta` unit cases (visible/flush/off-start/off-end/wider-than-viewport) + 3 `revealElementViaCamera` integration cases asserting it pans via `panBy` and leaves `host.scrollLeft/scrollTop` at 0 (the Bug B repro: an element past the right edge). **8/8 pass.** - **Gate:** `bun tsc --noEmit` → 6 errors, ALL the pre-existing DDR-026 baseline (api.ts ×3, context-menu.tsx, git/service.ts, runtime-bundle.ts) — 0 new. `biome check` clean (no errors/warnings) on both touched files. Related suites green: camera-reveal + dom-selection + canvas-rects + canvas-origin-gate = 28/28. - **Not yet manually verified in the live app** (Bug A drag-out / Bug B Layers-panel-click reveal in WKWebView) — deferred to the Stage-A/end manual pass + `/design:smoke` gate; the pure-math + integration test covers the regression class. Files touched: `apps/studio/canvas-shell.tsx`, `apps/studio/test/camera-reveal.test.tsx`. **Not committed** (holding per the shared-`main` convention — commit is the owner's call). ✅ **Stage B — Curated-knob expansion (Position / Transform / Typography / Media) — DONE.** Reverses DDR-104 §3's OUT-list (DDR to be recorded in Task G1). - **B1** — extended `KNOB_PROPS` (`dom-selection.ts`) with `position`/`top`/`right`/`bottom`/`left`/`z-index`/`transform`/`transform-origin`/`font-style`/`text-transform`/`text-decoration`/`white-space`/`overflow`/`object-fit`/`aspect-ratio`/`object-position`. Every added prop MUST have a curated row (else it's excluded from the Advanced hatch AND has no row = invisible) — all do. - **B2** — added `CSS_POSITION`/`CSS_FONT_STYLE`/`CSS_TEXT_TRANSFORM`/`CSS_TEXT_DECORATION`/`CSS_WHITE_SPACE`/`CSS_OBJECT_FIT`/`CSS_OVERFLOW` option lists in `app.jsx`. - **B3** — new **Position** section (after Layout): `position` via `csel`, a `top/right/bottom/left` **inset widget** (new `inset()` helper mirroring `side()` but bare-longhand + negative-allowed + `auto` default; reuses the box-model scrub grammar), a `static`-position relevance note, `z-index` via `num`. New CSS `.st-cp-boxv--i{t,r,b,l}`/`.st-cp-boxtag--i`/`.st-cp-boxcore--pos` in `3-shell-maude.css`. - **B4** — Typography extras (`font-style`/`text-transform`/`text-decoration`/`white-space` via `csel`) + `transform`/`transform-origin` free-value rows in Appearance (mirror box-shadow). - **B5** — conditional **Media** section (after Size), rendered only for `img`/`video`/`picture`/`svg`/`canvas` OR a selection already carrying a framing prop: `object-fit` (`csel`), `object-position`+`aspect-ratio` (`text`). Comment marks the tab-host contract vs the photo-editor plan's "Photo" tab. - **B6** — code comments point at the Stage-G DDR reversal. - Registered all new props in `SECTION_PROPS` (section-reset) + `open` defaults (Position/Media expanded). - **Gate:** `bun tsc --noEmit` 0 new errors (dom-selection clean); `biome check` clean on dom-selection.ts (client/** is biome-ignored — built separately); app.jsx transpiles clean; **client bundle release-built OK** (`client.bundle.js` 807 KB, `styles.css` 210 KB) — validates app.jsx + new CSS bundle. dom-selection tests 5/5. ✅ **Stage C — Auto-open CSS panel on select — DONE + live-smoke-verified.** - **C1** — `maybeAutoOpenInspectorOnSelect(sel)` (App): opens the Inspector on the **CSS** tab for a fresh SINGLE selection, guarded by (a) the preference, (b) `sel.id` present, (c) `anyRightPanelOpenRef` false (never steal from an open panel). Wired into the `select` + `select-set` (single/array-head-length-1) branches. Refs (`autoOpenInspectorRef`, `anyRightPanelOpenRef`) keep the postMessage listener stale-closure-safe. - **C2** — `autoOpenInspector` state backed by `localStorage['maude-auto-open-inspector']` (default ON), View-menu checkbox "Auto-open Inspector on select" (new `autoopen` panel id + `onToggleAutoOpenInspector` prop threaded to `Menubar`). - **Live smoke (agent-browser, freshly-built binary on :4400):** shell boots, **0 console errors**; View menu shows the new toggle directly under "Inspector"; `localStorage` default reads `"1"`. The full ⌘-click→auto-open-on-CSS-with-new-sections path needs a cross-origin canvas selection (not agent-browser-drivable in the normal path — same ceiling as phase-12.1 drag) → deferred to the Stage-G scenario `element-editing-resize-and-position`. - Files touched (B+C): `apps/studio/dom-selection.ts`, `apps/studio/client/app.jsx`, `apps/studio/client/styles/3-shell-maude.css` (+ rebuilt `dist/client.bundle.js`/`dist/styles.css`/`dist/comment-mount.js`/binary — release form). **Not committed.** 🟡 **Stage D — On-canvas drag-resize — D1/D2/D3 DONE (element resize); D4 (artboard resize) remains.** - **D1** — new `apps/studio/use-element-resize.tsx`: pure `computeElementResize(corner, start, dxW, dyW, mods, flags)` (world-unit deltas → target box; derives left/top by holding the opposite edge fixed — Figma grammar; Shift=aspect-lock, Alt=from-center; 1px min clamp) + `ElementResizeOverlay` (rAF-follows the selected element's screen box, 8 constant-size handles, pointerdown→capture→preview via direct inline style→pointerup posts `dgn:'resize-request'`). In-flow elements write width/height only (never convert-to-absolute); out-of-flow additionally move left/top on a top/left-edge drag (guarded by an inline-value present flag). Composes with ReorderDrag for free — handles are fixed overlay divs outside the artboard, so ReorderDrag's `el.contains(target)` gate never fires for them. - **D2** — mounted `` in `canvas-shell.tsx` next to `` (+ import). Live-verified: the Smoke TSX canvas mounts clean with the overlay (no shared-runtime break). - **D3** — shell-side `resizeElement(id, patch, before)` in `app.jsx` (sibling to `repositionElement`): chains `/_api/edit-css` writes for each present prop (width/height/left/top) on the shared `editApplyChainRef`, records one undo entry per prop, posts `resize-failed` on error (overlay restores the pre-drag inline box). New `resize-request` onMessage handler pinned to `activePath` (confused-deputy guard, DDR-138/054) + `resizeElementRef` wiring. - **Tests:** `test/element-resize.test.ts` — 9 cases (SE/E/S plain, NW out-of-flow opposite-corner-fixed, NW in-flow no-origin-move, W edge, Shift aspect 2:1, Alt from-center, min clamp). **9/9.** tsc 0 new · biome clean · client bundle rebuilt. - **Live-drag NOT yet verified** (cross-origin canvas selection + synthetic handle drag — same ceiling as phase-12.1) → Stage-G scenario `element-editing-resize-and-position` covers it. - **Stage-H coupling note:** resize writes via `edit-css` on the element's cd-id — for a shared-component INNER element this changes all instances, exactly as the existing CssKnobs edits already do (resize introduces NO new unpredictability). Stage H adds the scope badge covering ALL edit types (knob/move/resize) + per-occurrence routing for instance wrappers. Landing D before H on `main` is fine (commit-only, not pushed; H before feature close). **D4 (free-hand artboard resize via edit-attr width/height, DDR-027) still to do.** ✅ **Stage D4 (free-hand artboard resize) — backend DONE in the new-write-route batch (below); overlay UI DONE 2026-07-07.** Investigation finding: the active `DCArtboard` `
` (`canvas-lib.tsx:1849`) carries `data-dc-screen` but **no `data-cd-id`**, and its rendered size comes from the layout `rect` (seeded by the JSX `width`/`height` props per DDR-027), not a resolvable inline value. So artboard resize can't ride edit-css on a cd-id — it needed (a) a **new main-origin route** keyed by the artboard's `id` prop (`/_api/resize-artboard`, shipped in the batch below), AND (b) a **numeric-attr engine change** (`applyResizeArtboard`/`writeNumericAttr` writes `width={N}` not `"N"`, also shipped below). > - **Overlay UI (2026-07-07).** `use-element-resize.tsx`'s `ElementResizeOverlay` now activates for a whole-ARTBOARD selection too (`Selection.id` undefined + `Selection.artboardId` set — the chrome-click case `resolveHoverTarget` already produces). Renders **growth-only E/S/SE handles** (no NW/N/W/SW/NE/SE-left-moving variants, no rotate zones) — a deliberate scope choice: an artboard IS `position:absolute` in the DOM (world x/y from layout meta), but the resize route only ever writes `width`/`height` PROPS, never touches `layout.artboards[].x/y`; allowing a left/top-moving handle would preview a shift that snaps back on the next reload. Restricting to the bottom-right quadrant makes the live preview and the persisted result agree by construction. New `ElResizeDrag.artboardId: string | null` + `postResizeArtboardRequest()` (posts plain-number `width`/`height`, not px strings — matches what the shell's `resize-artboard-request` handler expects); `computeFromEvent` ignores Alt/center for an artboard drag (without a left/top write, "center" would just double the growth speed with no recentering). `structuralWrite` gained an `onFail` callback (previously silent-on-failure); `resizeArtboardShell` wires it to a new `resize-artboard-failed` postMessage so a rejected/422 write restores the pre-drag inline box (mirrors the existing `resize-failed`/`reposition-failed` revert pattern — closes a gap the earlier backend-only landing didn't have, since it had no live preview to revert). **Gate:** tsc 6/6 baseline 0 new · biome clean (fixed 1 new `useExhaustiveDependencies` + 1 format nit from the artboardOnly dep) · targeted tests 21/21 (element-resize + structural-api + origin-gate) · full suite 2111/1/0 unaffected · client bundle release-rebuilt, boot smoke green (`resize-artboard-request`/`resize-artboard-failed` present in the served bundle). ✅ **Stage E — Element selection + inspect on DS specimens — DONE (structural + build-verified).** No new route (reuses edit-css/edit-attr). - **E1** — `canvas-comment-mount.tsx`: new `pickSpecimenSelectEl` (generalizes `pickSpecimenEl` — climbs to the hit's own `data-cd-id`, else nearest stamped ancestor; specimens ARE stamped, the line-91 "not stamped" comment was stale) + a **capture-phase specimen-select listener** in `CommentHost` (Cmd/Ctrl-click). Self-gated on `isBareSpecimen()` at event time: a UI canvas has its own CanvasShell select router (specimens have none), so this is the ONLY select handler on a specimen and a pure no-op on a UI canvas — deliberately **NOT** added to the shared `COMMENT_CLAIMS` (which would `preventDefault`+`stopImmediatePropagation` a UI canvas's own select in capture phase — verified in input-router). `selSet.replace/add` auto-posts `dgn:'select-set'` (use-selection-set.tsx:132) → Inspector opens (Stage C) + edits persist. - **E2** — new `MountSelectionHalo` (mirrors `MountHoverHalo`, steadier accent outline) + mounts `` **gated on an `isSpecimen` state** (specimen-only — a UI canvas already mounts one inside CanvasShell; double-mount would double the handles). Key enabler: `ElementResizeOverlay` is **camera-agnostic** (reads `useSelectionSet`/`useToolMode` + `getBoundingClientRect`, no viewport-controller dep) and lives in its own `use-element-resize.tsx`, so importing it into the lite mount adds ~8 KB and pulls in NO canvas-shell. `pickSpecimenEl` exclusion extended so the overlay chrome isn't itself selectable. - **E3** — write path already generic over any cd-id; mechanism verified (select-set post + edit-css). Live specimen Cmd-click→select→edit deferred to the Stage-G scenario `specimen-and-media-editing`. - **Gate:** tsc 6 baseline/0 new · biome clean · comment-mount.js rebuilt 42.5→50.6 KB (no shell bloat) · tests: comment-mount 5/5, canvas-hmr + comments-overlay + element-resize + camera-reveal 28/28. Files: `apps/studio/canvas-comment-mount.tsx` + `dist/comment-mount.js`. > **Remaining: NEW-WRITE-ROUTE BATCH — D4 (artboard resize), F (media swap + AssetPicker + `/_api/assets` GET), I (structural delete/insert/artboard + routes + undo commands) — do together, then Stage-G3 `/flow:validate-security` over all of them.** NO-new-route stages still to do: H (component edit-scope badge; maybe a small GET), J (on-canvas spacing drag, reuses edit-css), L (editor ergonomics ×7; L3 duplicate couples to I's insert engine), M (flex/auto-layout ×3, reuses edit-css knobs). Then G1 (DDR), G2 (tests), G4 (what's-new). Executing one stage at a time, checkpointing here. 🟢 **NEW-WRITE-ROUTE BATCH (backend layer) — DONE this session (2026-07-07, uncommitted on `main`).** Built the whole engine + route + undo + security-gate + test layer for the four structural/artboard ops; delete is fully UX-wired, the other three are backend-ready with shell plumbing but need canvas-side affordance UI (deferred within this batch). > - **Key architecture decision:** the undo for ALL four new ops **reuses the existing reorder command** (`commands/reorder-command.ts`, `op:'reorder'` `record-edit` → whole-file `/_api/reorder-revert` seq swap) — NO new `commands/delete-element-command.ts`/`insert-element-command.ts` files were needed. The reorder command is already the generic "whole-file seq revert" command (the DDR-150 clip ops reuse it too via `logUndo`). A structural edit renumbers positional ids, so an inverse descriptor goes stale — exactly the reason reorder uses the server seq log — so reuse is correct, not a shortcut. This SUPERSEDES the plan's Task-I2 five-part-wiring assumption + the "Custom Components: delete/insert undo commands" row. > - **Engine (`canvas-edit.ts`, pure + reparse-gated + on-disk async wrappers):** `applyDeleteElement`/`deleteElement` (spanWithFraming remove + resolveUsageId for shared-instance), `applyInsertElement`/`insertElement` (synthesize div/text/image w/o cd-id, place via applyMove's anchor+indent logic, recompute new post-transpile id by insert-offset match, image src contained), `applyResizeArtboard`/`resizeArtboard` (D4 — new `writeNumericAttr` writes `width={N}` NOT `"N"`; addresses `` by its `id` PROP since the rendered `
` has no cd-id), `applyInsertArtboard`/`insertArtboard` (empty `` after the last, dup-id + injection-guard). Helpers: `collectJsxByTag`, `synthInsertElement`, `InsertKind` type, `ARTBOARD_ID_RE`. > - **api.ts:** `deleteElementOp`/`insertElementOp`/`insertArtboardOp`/`resizeArtboardOp` — reuse `resolveCanvasAbs` + `logUndo` + `history.writeSnapshot` + activity-rim suppress/unsuppress (exact reorder pattern); registered in the `Api` interface + returned object. > - **http.ts:** `/_api/delete-element`, `/_api/insert-element`, `/_api/insert-artboard`, `/_api/resize-artboard` — MAIN-ORIGIN ONLY (absent from CANVAS_SAFE_API + startCanvasServer routes), `sameOriginWrite` CSRF + `isLoopbackHost` DNS-rebinding gated, 8 KB body cap. Added all four to `canvas-origin-gate.test.ts`'s main-origin allowlist (GET→403 from canvas origin). > - **Client (`app.jsx`):** `structuralWrite` helper + `deleteElementShell`/`insertElementShell`/`insertArtboardShell`/`resizeArtboardShell` (POST + record-edit undo + best-effort re-select via pendingReorderRef) + refs; onMessage handlers `delete-request`/`insert-request`/`insert-artboard-request`/`resize-artboard-request`, each `e.source===activeWin` confused-deputy-gated + pinned to `activePath`. > - **Canvas affordances (`canvas-shell.tsx` + `use-keyboard-discipline.tsx`):** element context-menu "Delete" (destructive) + "Insert ▸ Div/Text"; Del/Backspace key → `delete-request` (text-focus-guarded, `one.index` as idIndex = usage index for shared instances). > - **Tests:** `test/element-structural-edit.test.ts` (15 pure-engine cases) + `test/element-structural-api.test.ts` (3 route round-trips incl. CSRF-403 + undo-revert + dup-422). Full: `bun tsc` 6/6 baseline 0 new · biome clean on touched TS · **element-structural + reorder-api + canvas-edit + canvas-origin-gate = 61/61**. Client bundle rebuilt `--release` (client.bundle.js 811 KB) + darwin-arm64 binary; **boot smoke:** health 200, all 4 handlers in served bundle, `/_api/delete-element` bad-id→400. **Live ⌘-click→delete/insert in WKWebView deferred to the Stage-G scenario** (cross-origin canvas selection — same ceiling as phase-12.1 drag). **UI-smoke gate note:** diff touches `apps/studio/**` but NOT rendering paths (canvas-lib/templates) — boot smoke covers "still renders"; full `/design:smoke` folded into the Stage-G scenario like Stages A–E. > - **REMAINING in this batch:** I3 image-insert (needs Stage-F AssetPicker src) + tool-palette "+ Element" place-mode; I4 "+ Artboard" affordance + `SCREEN_PRESETS` picker + `patchCanvasMeta` grid; D4 `ElementResizeOverlay` artboard-scope extension (address by id prop, post `resize-artboard-request`). Then Stage F, then G3 security fan-out over the 4 new routes. > - **Files touched (committed `249218d`):** `apps/studio/canvas-edit.ts`, `api.ts`, `http.ts`, `client/app.jsx`, `canvas-shell.tsx`, `use-keyboard-discipline.tsx`, `test/element-structural-edit.test.ts` (new), `test/element-structural-api.test.ts` (new), `test/canvas-origin-gate.test.ts`, `dist/client.bundle.js`. 🟢 **STAGE F (media swap — F1 + F2) — DONE this session (2026-07-07, uncommitted on `main`).** The AssetPicker + Replace-media path, verified end-to-end. > - **F1 AssetPicker** — new shell modal (`AssetPicker` in `app.jsx`) listing versioned `assets/` via a new **MAIN-ORIGIN-ONLY `GET /_api/assets`** (`api.listAssets` — image/video only, newest-first, capped 500; loopback-Host gated; added to canvas-origin-gate allowlist) + **upload** (reuses `POST /_api/asset`). Thumbnails load from the main-origin designRoot static serve (`/${designRel}/${path}`), never a remote hotlink (CSP split origin). **fetch-by-URL deferred** (needs a host-allowlisted download route — security-sensitive). > - **F2 Replace media** — element context-menu "Replace image…" (reads the authored `src` off the element for the undo before-value) + a Media-section "Replace…" button (gated to ``/`
