decision.rationale:
Execution Progress — feature-video-animation-layer (2026-07-03, branch `main`)

Remotion-authored video comps (in-house bundled) + capture-first GIF/MP4 export. Plan: `.ai/plans/feature-video-animation-layer.md`. **DDR-148.** Executing via /flow:execute on `main` (commit-only-own-files per concurrency memory).
- ✅ **T1** DDR-148 recorded + indexed (README). Hybrid decision (Remotion authoring in-house, capture-spine export), license disclosure posture (free ≤3-person; NOT MIT), determinism contract, threat-table video widening.
- ✅ **T2** Runtime bundles + video-comp canvas kind — **fully verified live.** (a) Added `remotion`+`@remotion/player`+`@remotion/transitions`+6 core presentation subpaths (fade/slide/wipe/flip/clock-wipe/none) to `RUNTIME_PACKAGES` (pnpm-installed `remotion@4.0.484`/`mediabunny@1.50.6`/`gifenc@1.0.3`, +10 pkgs); pre-built 9 minified bundles into `dist/runtime/` (remotion 187KB/player 85KB/transitions 56KB/presentations 0.5–50KB), `.min-sizes.json` floors, importmap entries in `_shell.html`, `REMOTION-LICENSE.md` passthrough. **check-runtime-bundles 22/22 above floor.** Externalization proof: `remotion` = single React-context source (player/transitions inline stateless no-react + paths/shapes — no dual-package frozen-at-0 hazard). (b) `video-comp.tsx` (`VideoComp` mounts `<Player>` + `window.__maude_seek__`/`__maudeVideoComps`/`__maude_comps__` seek bridge + `dgn:timeline-*` postMessage), re-exported from canvas-lib. **Live-verified via agent-browser**: scratch comp (MAUDE→fade→VIDEO TransitionSeries) mounts, registers, renders; `__maude_seek__(20)` twice = **pixel-identical sha1** (determinism ✓); frame 65 → seq B local-frame 35 (transition-overlap math correct). `test/video-comp.test.ts` 6/6. In-shell one-time license notice folded into T10 disclosure + T8 bundle rebuild.
- ✅ **T3** Asset route widened for video/audio. `sniffAssetType` (superset of `sniffImageType`: mp4/mov ISO-BMFF ftyp-brands, webm EBML, mp3 ID3/frame-sync, wav RIFF/WAVE, m4a) → `{ext, category}`; per-category caps (image 10MB tight, video/audio `ASSET_MAX_VIDEO_BYTES` 100MB env-overridable); `ASSET_SESSION_BUDGET` 256MB→1GB. **Streamed write** — new `saveAssetFromStream(ReadableStream)` reads via explicit `getReader()` (Bun `req.body` has NO Symbol.asyncIterator — `for await` throws), sniffs head, caps mid-stream, writes to `.tmp-*` → sha8 content-address → dedupe-rename; `saveAsset(bytes)` now a thin wrapper. HTTP route streams `req.body` (no 100MB ArrayBuffer in RAM); `MAX_REQUEST_BODY` raised to video-cap+8MB (streamed asset route memory-safe; other buffering routes keep logical caps — documented tradeoff). Dual-allowlist unchanged (route already both lists; GET→405 preserved). Tests: `test/video-asset.test.ts` (11: sniff matrix + streaming endpoint + per-cap 413 + dedupe + no-temp-leak) + asset-api (11, contract preserved) + canvas-origin-gate green. **40/40 across all touched suites.** biome clean.
- **Regression gate (T1–T3):** full dev-server suite **1878 pass / 1 skip / 0 fail** (171 files) — the security-load-bearing edits (api.ts asset route, server.ts body cap, http.ts, runtime-bundle.ts) break nothing. biome clean on touched files. **Dist-churn caution:** the full-suite boot regenerated dev-form bundles (client.bundle.js + existing runtime/*.js); restored to HEAD; the 9 new Remotion bundles were also churned to dev-form → **rebuilt release-minified** (remotion 191612 / player 86601 / none 550). Final dist = only my Remotion additions; floor guard 22/22.
- ✅ **T1–T3 COMMITTED** `d18ac98` (foundation, on `main`, not pushed).
- ✅ **T5 capture shim** `bin/_video-playwright.mjs` — reuses the DDR-041 world-reset/artboard-pin; steps `__maude_seek__(f)` (comp) or getAnimations/`<video>`.currentTime (ordinary `--mode`); `--dump-frames` sink. **Determinism PROVEN live:** two 60-frame runs of a scratch comp = **0/60 mismatched sha1** (60 unique frames within a run); frame 30 shows correct per-frame content. Frame cap 900 (30s).
- ✅ **T6 in-page encoders** `exporters/video-encode-lib.ts` (bundled via new `_browser-bundles.getEncodeLibBundle`, injected as an ESM module script → `window.__maudeEnc`): mediabunny `Output`+`CanvasSource` (H.264/avc MP4, VP9/VP8 WebM fallback via `getFirstEncodableVideoCodec`) + gifenc `quantize`/`applyPalette`. Frame round-trip = screenshot→base64→page→`createImageBitmap`→OffscreenCanvas. **Verified live:** MP4 = valid H.264 (ffprobe: 482×272, exactly 2.0s/60 frames, ftyp+moov+mdat+avcC); GIF = 89a animated, correct first frame. Audio mix deferred (documented in lib).
- ✅ **T7 exporter wiring** `exporters/video.ts` (mp4/webm/gif adapters, scope artboard, options fps/durationMs/frames/gifColors, MAX_FRAMES 900, mp4→webm ext fallback from summary) registered in `exporters/index.ts` Format union+REGISTRY; `export.md` updated (formats+temporal section+examples). **`runExport({format:'mp4',scope:'artboard'})` verified live** → `ui-_videocomp_smoke.mp4` video/mp4 45KB + `.gif` 58KB. Exporter suite **61/0**, biome clean. ⌘E dialog cards (`app.jsx EXPORT_CARDS`, hardcoded) = client change folded into T8's bundle rebuild.
- ✅ **T5–T7 COMMITTED** `7005d30` (export path, on `main`, not pushed).
- ✅ **T9 skill + routing + critic** `plugins/design/skills/video-comp/SKILL.md` (Remotion iron rules: frame-driven only / no CSS anim in comps / bundled-imports-only / assets-only; `<VideoComp>` + comp meta; Series/TransitionSeries/6 presentations vocabulary; worked "4 clips + crossfades + music bed" example; export recipe; license note). Routing cues added: `new.md` (video-brief cue → scaffold `<VideoComp>`) + `edit.md` §0.6 (EN+CZ grep `video|klip|animace|mp4|gif|hudba|…` OR `<VideoComp` in active canvas → load skill). `motion-critic.md` extended: axis 10 (video-comp Remotion hard-checks) + axis 11 (**live 2-sample motion proof** — seek two frames, identical = HARD fail, DDR-094 §6). `plugin-cli-reachability.test.mjs` green (2/2). Markdown-only, no bundle rebuild.
- ✅ **T9 COMMITTED** `b746c4d` (skill + routing + critic, on `main`, not pushed).
- ✅ **T10 docs/whats-new/roadmap** — `whats-new.json` entry `video-comp-remotion` (kind feature, version null → stamped at release; validated); site docs page `site/content/docs/design/video.mdx` (+ meta.json nav) incl. the Remotion license disclosure section (free ≤3-person, 4+ bring own license, no renderer binaries/telemetry); README design row touched; `gen:roadmap` re-run (roadmap.json diff included). Email draft already present at `.ai/plans/notes/remotion-license-email.md` (release-gated, not merge-gated). NOTE: full `pnpm --filter @maude/site build` deferred to /done (video.mdx is plain markdown — low risk).
- ✅ **T10 COMMITTED** `7cadcc2` (docs/whats-new/roadmap, on `main`, not pushed).
- ✅ **T8 Timeline panel + ⌘E cards** — `client/panels/TimelinePanel.jsx` (transport play/pause/loop + scrub + frame·time readout + playhead track, maude tokens, data-testids `timeline-panel`/`-playpause`/`-loop`/`-scrub`/`-playhead`/`-readout`/`-track`/`-empty`); wired into app.jsx right dock (mutual-exclusion via openRightPanel/toggleRightPanel), View-menu "Timeline" toggle (+ "video" tag when `hasComps`), `timeline-comps`/`timeline-frame` inbound handlers (active-window gated, clamped), reset-on-canvas-switch + `timeline-request-comps` re-sync (added responder to video-comp.tsx). ⌘E `EXPORT_CARDS` gains MP4+GIF (temporal, gated on `hasComps`) + `mp4/gif/webm: ['artboard']` scopes. CSS in `3-shell-maude.css`. **Bundle rebuilt `--release`** (client 758→763KB, styles 201→204KB; runtime bundles skipped/intact). **Live-verified via agent-browser (full app):** comp announces → panel "30 fps · 60f" → View toggle → scrub to frame 45 **drives the Player across the origin split** (canvas renders "▶ 45" @ 0:01/0:02) → playhead 76.27% + readout track → switch to static canvas resets to EMPTY; ⌘E shows MP4+GIF cards only with a comp. biome ignores client JSX (video-comp.tsx clean). **v1 scope note:** per-sequence rows + drag-to-retime (source-patch) DEFERRED — needs a raw-source read endpoint + canvas-edit patch (documented in TimelinePanel.jsx); v1 is transport+scrub over the whole comp (Player already gives per-sequence structure visually).
- ✅ **T8 COMMITTED** `7f855e0` (Timeline panel + ⌘E cards, on `main`, not pushed).
- ✅ **T4 media-drop (core)** — `use-canvas-media-drop.tsx` classifier now recognizes `video/*`+`audio/*` files → `{kind:'media', mediaKind}` (image still wins on a co-drop); default handler uploads via the widened asset route (Task 3) + toasts the `assets/<sha8>.<ext>` path + a copied `<Video>`/`<Audio src>` snippet (>20MB size warning). `mediaSnippet` + `uploadAndAnnounceMedia` exported; optional `onMedia` callback seam for a future host. Previously a dropped clip did **nothing**; now it lands in the project + hands you the snippet. `canvas-media-drop.test.ts` +5 (26/0), biome clean. Runs in the canvas iframe (no committed-bundle rebuild). **DEFERRED (documented):** the full AST auto-insert of `<Video>` into the comp TSX — has a real design question (media belongs INSIDE the composition function, not the DCArtboard body, so the insert point is ambiguous for comps) → needs `insertMediaElement` + a raw-source read + a main-origin write route + iframe→shell hop; scoped as a follow-up.
- ✅ **T4 COMMITTED** `7430bce` (media-drop core, on `main`, not pushed).
- ✅ **T11 E2E + fixture** — `test/fixtures/video-comp-fixture.tsx` (canonical comp: animated title + 2-clip `TransitionSeries` crossfade + `<Audio>` envelope) + `test/video-comp-fixture.test.ts` (2, CI-safe): builds through `buildCanvasModule` asserting remotion/@remotion/transitions/`fade` externalize + `<VideoComp>`/`__maude_seek__` inlined + every remotion specifier is a known RUNTIME_PACKAGE. **Full regression sweep 1884 pass / 1 skip / 0 fail (172 files)** — the whole feature (incl. heavy T8 app.jsx) breaks nothing. Live E2E was verified piecemeal throughout: render (screenshots), determinism (0/60 sha1), MP4 (ffprobe H.264 2.0s/60f)/GIF encode, export dispatch (45KB mp4/58KB gif), timeline scrub (frame 45 across origin split), drop classification. dist churn from the sweep restored to committed release bundles (floor 22/22).

### Video-comp edit-persistence smoke + re-verify (2026-07-04, branch `main`)
User still reported "letter color reverts on replay/loop" AFTER the round-1 fix. **Exhaustively re-verified on the current build — edits persist in EVERY path** (agent-browser, real edit-css): source write persists; fresh load renders it; standalone shell live-reload PAUSED + PLAYING; **full-app canvas-origin iframe** (localhost:split) live-reload; and the hardest case — **edit color WHILE the comp is looping in the full app → letters stayed cyan through pause+seek**. Conclusion: the permanent-revert cause was the `editStyleProp` double-comma (a build failure → Player rendered OLD source), **fixed in `83931ce`** — a stale bundle would still show it (⌘R / restart to get the current build). Added `test/edit-persistence.test.ts` (3, CI-safe): a CSS edit (swap / insert-next-to-trailing-comma / edit sequence) must survive into the **built module** (source→edit→buildCanvasModule→assert value present) — the guard that would have caught the original bug (`opacity: o, , color` → build throw → old render). 38/0 with canvas-edit. No source/bundle change this round; demo letter color reset to `#f0ece5`.

### Video-comp: 4 dogfood bugs fixed (agent-browser verified) (2026-07-04, branch `main`)
User hit 4 bugs; all reproduced + fixed live via agent-browser (canvas-origin split). (1) **Timeline didn't follow the artboard** — root: canvas-lib computes `activeArtboardId` (nearest viewport centre, drives the blue ring) but never reported it to the shell; added a `dgn:'active-artboard'` postMessage on change → app tracks `canvasActiveArtboard` (active-window gated) and the timeline re-parses to it (over `selected.artboardId`). **Verified: pan intro-centre → 112f Intro/Payoff; pan reel-centre → 228f TitleCard+music.** (2) **ClipShot black + (3) no audio** — SAME root: the hardened canvas-origin CSP had `default-src 'none'` and **no `media-src`**, so every `<Video>`/`<Audio>` was blocked. Added `media-src 'self' blob:` (http.ts) — same inert-bytes trust as `img-src 'self'`. **Verified: reel renders the real footage; music element plays (currentTime 3.48→4.88s) once the iframe has sticky activation from a canvas click.** (3b) added a **volume slider** to the transport (posts `timeline-volume`→`PlayerRef.setVolume`; unmutes on drag). (4) **Resizable timeline** — drag-the-top-edge handle (`onResize`, clamp 140–640px). **Verified: 216→376px, all rows + music waveform visible.** `canvas-origin-gate.test.ts` +media-src assertion. Full suite **1899 pass/1 skip/0 fail**; client rebuilt --release. Note: preview audio needs the sticky in-iframe gesture (a canvas click) before programmatic play emits sound; exported-mp4 audio-mux still open.

### Video-comp: timeline-as-control-surface (2026-07-04, branch `main`)
Dogfood follow-ups on the 2-comp canvas: (1) **Timeline follows the selected artboard** — `parseCompTimeline(src, total, selectedArtboardId)` tags each `<VideoComp>` with its enclosing `<DCArtboard id>` and scopes to the SELECTED artboard's comp (falls back to media/duration/first); app fetches source once then re-parses on `selected` change, so switching artboards redraws the timeline. (2) **Player chrome removed from the artboard** — `VideoComp` `controls` now defaults OFF (`(controls ?? false) && !capturing`); the Timeline is the sole transport. (3) **Sound moved to the Timeline** — a mute button in the transport (shown when the comp has audio) posts `timeline-mute`/`timeline-volume` to the scoped comp (`PlayerRef.mute/unmute/setVolume`); play syncs mute first. Also (prior, same session) fixed the timeline driving ALL comps (id-targeted messages, commit 21c5257) + switched the reel to `<Video>` (reliable Player render). **Known:** preview audio is subject to browser autoplay policy — a cross-origin canvas iframe needs an in-iframe user gesture (the user's canvas click) before programmatic play emits sound; and the EXPORTED mp4 is still silent (audio-mux is the open TODO). `timeline-parse.test.ts` +1 (artboard scope). Full suite **1899 pass/1 skip/0 fail**; client rebuilt --release. Demo canvas (Video switch + no chrome) stays local.

### Video-comp real-footage reel + music layer (2026-07-04, branch `main`)
User: a 2nd artboard on the intro canvas = a REAL MP4 strih (downloaded clips) + light motion graphics, + a music bed visible as a timeline layer. **Shipped + live-verified.** Code (the feature): (1) **canvas-origin video/audio serving** — `.mp4/.m4v/.mov/.webm/.mp3/.wav/.m4a/.ogg` added to `http.ts` MIME + `CANVAS_ASSET_EXTS` so a comp `<Video>`/`<Audio>` loads from `assets/` inside the untrusted iframe (inert bytes, nosniff); (2) **timeline music layer** — `timeline-parse.js` now emits `audio[]` rows from `<Audio src>` + `TimelinePanel` renders a distinct teal waveform row (`♪ music.mp3`); (3) **multi-comp scoping** — the parser picks the media comp (Video/Audio) among several `<VideoComp>`s + reads its total/fps, and resolves EXPRESSION consts (`const TOTAL = A+B-XF`) so a derived duration parses; (4) **video-seek-aware capture** — `bin/_video-playwright.mjs` comp-mode now waits for every `<video>` to land on its seeked frame (readyState/`seeked`, 1.5 s cap) before the screenshot — else the export catches stale frames. `timeline-parse.test.ts` +2 (audio row, multi-comp scope). **Live:** reel renders 3 real clips (drone→jellyfish→animation) with fade/slide/wipe + lower-thirds + progress bar + REC HUD + end card; timeline shows 5 seq rows + the `♪ music.mp3` row @ 228f; exported MP4 (1.5 MB, 7.6 s) verified to contain the real footage + overlays baked in (sampled clip A + the B→C wipe). Full suite **1896 pass/1 skip/0 fail**; client rebuilt --release. **Demo held OUT of git** (canvas + ~6.5 MB downloaded stock footage + export) pending the user's call — public repo + third-party clip licensing.

Execution Progress — Phase 12.2 + 12.3 (in-canvas CSS panel — proper UX) — **DONE 2026-06-12 via /flow:done, plan archived, user-confirmed working live** (12.2: `ef4c96b`+`a06e79d`+`6130ebb`+`228676c`; 12.3: `8c17097`…`773db42`; NOT pushed; acceptance criteria all checked; awaiting push/PR — squash-merge as 1aGh)

> **Phase 12.3 (round 2/3 live-iteration, 2026-06-12):** maude-DS alignment of the whole right panel · unified Figma-style HSV colour picker (collapsed two popovers) · row-chrome consolidation (reset+status → one leading provenance dot) · Variables as a searchable cross-DS list (natvrdo literal apply) · unset rows recede · A1/A2/A3 optimistic-apply echo-guard security hardening (DDR-105 §Addendum, `773db42`). See the plan's "Phase 12.3" + "Retro" sections (archived).

> Plan: `.ai/plans/phase-12.2-css-panel-ux.md` (reinforced with competitive + heuristic UX research). Methodology = **design-as-canvas-first → critic ≥ 4.0 → port to `app.jsx` → live-verify**. Decided model: Hybrid vocabulary (friendly section headers + CSS-named rows), curated ~14 controls, token-first per-field dropdowns, two fenced escape hatches. DDR-104. Reconciliation: current `CssKnobs` (app.jsx:2878) already reads authored values + has swatch + RawKnob → this is evolution, not rewrite (Tasks 0/2/3 partly pre-done).

- [x] **Task 0** — DDR-104 written + indexed (value-source = DOM-authored; vocabulary = Hybrid; curated set + OUT-list; token-source = `system/<ds>`; provenance model). _(this session)_
- [x] **Tasks 1–7 (design)** — canvas-first spec built + render-verified (`Studio.tsx` `CssPanelMock` → artboard E; `Studio.css` `.st-cp-*`). Iter-1 critic fixes folded in: live small text `--fg-3`→`--fg-2` (WCAG AA), SHAPE-coded provenance (circle/square/ring + per-row `role=img`), colour swatch moved INSIDE token field (fixes control-left rail), 24px+ targets (bind/seg/box inputs), opacity `role=slider`+aria + real `<button>` steppers, `aria-describedby` shadow-warn, copy fixes (direct style / overrides the padding set in Spacing / used as-is — not linked to a token / + Add CSS property / + Add HTML attribute / link sides / Advanced), save success border, box-model legibility + per-widget provenance.
- [x] **Critic ≥ 4.0 — PASSED (6-critic panel).** iter-1→iter-2: a11y 2.5→**4.6**, typography 3.4→**4.4**, graphic 3.9→**4.4**; design **4.3**, copy **4.1**, signature-moment **4.7**. All ≥4.0, **0 blockers**. Verified via 3 fresh zoom-neutralized 1:1 captures + source re-read. Remaining = minor non-blocking lifts (light-theme `--status-warn` 3.22:1, `is-zero` box-value dimming, Advanced-field visual demotion, box-model right-gutter inset) → fold into the port or defer.
- [x] **Post-critic user iteration (`/design:edit`)** — 5 in-canvas comments + Layout ask, all applied to the spec (DDR-104 addendum): **Layout section added** (display/flex-direction/align-items/justify-content + gap moved here), **collapsible sections** (`aria-expanded` headers; Size shown collapsed), **font-family + letter-spacing** added to Typography, **border-radius per-corner split** (TL/TR/BL/BR → longhand writes), **modifier-key chips → one `link all sides` toggle** (were confusing), **is-zero margins `--fg-3`→`--fg-2`** (legible l/r). Comments resolved. Render re-verified at 1:1 (canvas compiles, 5 sections + all new controls present, dist clean). Curated tier now ~19.
- [x] **Task 8 (port) — DONE.** `CssKnobs` rewritten (`app.jsx`, 240→739 lines) to the spec with real wiring: collapsible sections, **Layout** section, token quick-pick from **fetched DS tokens** (`useDsTokens` parses `/<tokensCssRel>` grouped by prefix), box-model **longhand** writes (`style.paddingTop`…) + link toggle, per-corner radius split (`border-top-left-radius`…), colour picker + token, steppers + unit selects, provenance computed from authored (`var(--`=bound / raw=override / absent=inherited), per-field save-state, **two hatches**: custom CSS property → `/_api/edit-css`, custom HTML attribute → **new `POST /_api/edit-attr`** (`api.editAttr` + http route + gate test; main-origin-only). `cfg` threaded App→InspectorPanel→CssKnobs. `.st-cp-*` CSS (165 lines) ported into `client/styles/3-shell-maude.css` (`@layer shell`) + port-only classes (native selects/inputs/save indicators). **Release rebuilt**: `client.bundle.js` 291 KB + `styles.css` 110 KB.
- [x] **Verify — DONE.** Release build clean (333 modules); biome clean (1 pre-existing unrelated warning); engine + origin-gate tests 22 pass (`/_api/edit-attr` 403 from canvas origin); **`/design:smoke` clean (87/87 canvases styled, import-graph clean)**; **live populated render verified** (real `CssKnobs` in the shell on an `h1` selection — Layout/Typography/Spacing render with native selects, box-model with real bounds, link toggle, collapsible sections, correct inherited-provenance for an un-styled element). Cross-origin Cmd+click round-trip (select→edit→source) = the documented hard-to-automate gap; the write path itself is test-covered + the selection-populated render confirms the UI path.
- [x] **Post-port bugfix** — `useDsTokens` fetched the tokens CSS at the **DS-root-relative** path (`/system/<ds>/colors_and_type.css`) → 404 on the main origin (which serves repo-relative); fix prepends `cfg.designRel` → `/.design/system/<ds>/colors_and_type.css` (200). Only affected the token dropdowns (caught fetch). Rebuilt (292 KB).
- [x] **User-reported "black/white screen" on CSS tab — TRUE ROOT CAUSE, FIXED (`228676c`).** After the key fix, the user STILL got the fragment (clean console, incognito, even `SPLIT=0`). Forensics via `elementFromPoint`: a bare `<span>` covered every label/header — the colour-swatch **fill span (`position:absolute; inset:0`)** anchored to `.maude` because the ported `.st-cp-swatch` had **no `position:relative`** (spec swatch was decorative-only; the old `.st-css-swatch` had it). The fill painted the selected element's **computed colour across the whole window** (dark → black screen, light → white) and the invisible color `<input>` swallowed clicks; only the box-model survived (own `position:relative`). Repro was selection-data-dependent (`computed.color` present → blanket; my synthetic injections without color → invisible overlay → looked "full"). Fix: `.st-cp-swatch { position: relative; overflow: hidden; }`. Verified with dark-colour selection: fill 16×16, clicks land, full render.
- [x] ~~User-reported "fragment" render~~ — earlier diagnosis (key collision, `6130ebb`) was real but SECONDARY; the swatch overlay above was the primary user-visible breakage.
- [x] **Prior FIXED note (`6130ebb`):** Panel rendered as just the floating box-model, no chrome. Root cause: the field inputs (box-model sides, num/text/corner/opacity) keyed `key={authored[prop] ?? ''}` → **empty key for any un-authored property** → 8 box-model siblings shared `key=""` → React "two children with the same key, ``" → children omitted. **Production react-dom (release bundle) tolerated it — which is why it rendered full in my agent-browser tests and I wrongly called it a stale/offline tab TWICE.** `react-dom.development` (the bundle a local `pnpm dev` self-heals into dist — dist was silently churned 291 KB→3.9 MB dev) OMITS the colliding children → the user-visible breakage. The user's incognito DEV console (`Encountered two children with the same key, `` … CssKnobs app.jsx:3193/3300`) was the smoking gun. Fix: `key={`${prop}:${authored[prop] ?? ''}`}` (unique). **Verified in the DEV bundle** (the user's scenario): 0 key warnings, full panel (6 sec / 20 rows / 8 box inputs). Lesson recorded in [[studio-shell-panel-live-verify]].
- [x] **Phase 12.3 (round 2/3) + A1/A2/A3 security hardening** — DONE 2026-06-12 (`8c17097`…`773db42`); DDR-105 §Addendum; security-review "Second pass"; plan Retro appended + archived.
- [ ] **Push / PR** — branch `worktree-buzzing-snuggling-manatee` (committed, NOT pushed). Squash-merge as 1aGh per repo rules.

- **Verify (executor):** dev-server `bun test` **1248/1248**; biome clean (exit 0, only pre-existing `<>` fragment warning); `tsc` 3 errors all DDR-026 baseline (api.ts:1426-7 + runtime-bundle.ts:333), **0 new**; `check-runtime-bundles.sh` 13/13 above floor (dist/ untouched — annotation code is in the dynamic per-canvas runtime, not committed bundles). **Live agent-browser smoke** (source server on :4577, Smoke TSX canvas): highlighter palette+translucent wide stroke ✓; multi-line text stacks 3 lines + persists across reload ✓; context toolbar B/I/S/U + bullet/numbered render+toggle ✓; numbered markers + italic ✓; dashed rect + default fill + dash control for shapes ✓; sticky renders ✓; theme-aware ink (dark ink on light canvas) ✓. Scribbles cleaned (gitignored), dev-build `dist/` reverted.
- **Follow-up fixes (user feedback 2026-06-04, live-verified):** (a) **theme-aware ink was reading the wrong attribute** — `useTheme()` reads DS `data-theme` (artboard palette, separate); the canvas BACKGROUND flips on chrome `data-maude-theme` (default dark, canvas-shell.tsx). Replaced with a `useCanvasChromeTheme()` hook reading `data-maude-theme` → new text on the default dark canvas now serializes `fill="#ededed"` (light, visible). (b) **highlighter cursor** now reuses the Kenney `drawing_pencil` (PEN) glyph instead of a bespoke marker — one unified Kenney library. (c) **highlighter nib widths** — added 3 sizes (10/18/28) with dot chips in the highlighter chrome (`highlighterWidth` state). (d) **list markers in the editor** — sticky + standalone + anchored editors now SHOW the `• `/`N. ` markers while editing (`listPrefixedBody`) and strip them generically on commit (`stripEditorMarkers`), so the read↔edit swap no longer flickers; round-trip verified clean (`data-list` preserved, no double-prefix). Live-verified via direct canvas-shell origin (port-split iframe): editor shows `• tadasda`, commits to clean `tadasda`; new text `#ededed` on dark; highlighter chrome shows 3 width dots. dev-server **1250/1250**; biome exit 0; tsc 3 DDR-026 baseline only.

Pen + highlighter are **vertically mirrored** (`FLIP_V = translate(0,32) scale(1,-1)`) so they lie along the top-right→bottom-left diagonal with the nib/lead at bottom-LEFT (fixes "kreslí pod koncem, ne na špičce"); hotspots at the tip (6,18). `kenney()` takes an optional `transform` string. Hotspots verified by rendering each glyph at 10× with a hotspot dot (all tips align). canvas-cursors.test 8/8; dev-server 1250/1250; biome exit 0; tsc 3 DDR-026 baseline only; dist reverted.
- **Text-editing unification (user steer 2026-06-04, `/flow:validate` focus):** added inline **formatting keyboard shortcuts** (Cmd/Ctrl + **B/I/U**) to ALL three editors via a shared `useEditorFormat` hook — they preventDefault the browser's native execCommand (which injected markup the model couldn't read → the shortcuts were previously a no-op), preview live, and the toggled bold/italic/underline (+ preserved strike) commit onto the stroke. Threaded an `EditorFmt` through `commitEditing` + all four writers (`commitText`/`commitStickyText`/`commitStandaloneText`/`createStandaloneText`) with `normFmt`/`fmtEqual` (identity short-circuit now also checks formatting). Unified the commit triggers: sticky gained Cmd+Enter commit + an Esc-suppress-blur guard (matching standalone/anchored). **Live-verified across all 3:** text-tool Cmd+B+I → bold+italic (live + persisted); sticky Cmd+B → bold; rect-anchored text Cmd+U → underline; Enter inserts a newline in all three. Test: +1 all-four-formats combined round-trip. dev-server **1251/1251**; CLI **exit 0**; biome exit 0; tsc 3 DDR-026 baseline only; dist reverted.

### UI add-on (per user request 2026-06-03) — create a blank brief board directly from the browser

User asked: "I thought I could create a new canvas directly in the UI?" — confirmed the dev-server had no create affordance (canvas creation only via `/design:new`). Built the UI path (chose option B = extend now; new server write-surface → own security pass).
- **Server:** `POST /_api/canvas` (`api.createCanvas` + `canvas-create.ts` pure helpers; http.ts route). MAIN-ORIGIN-ONLY — deliberately absent from `startCanvasServer`'s allowlist (DDR-054); the untrusted canvas iframe 403s it (asserted in `canvas-origin-gate.test.ts`). Security boundary = one strict name allowlist `/^[\p{L}\p{N}][\p{L}\p{N} _-]{0,59}$/u` (path + JSX + JSON injection) + group allowlist + designRoot containment + 409. Single-source template via build-time text-import (DDR-045-safe).

Fixed **F2** (group containment now asserts against designRoot — a poisoned config can't escape) + **NFC** normalization (clobber-bypass). **F1 (open, tracked in DDR-085):** the *ingest* path feeds untrusted annotation text verbatim to `ux-research-agent` (WebFetch + repo Read = lethal trifecta). Applied data-framing mitigation in new.md §6b.2; the architectural close (outbound-allowlisted research context) is a **follow-up decision for the user**.
- **Verify:** dev-server suite 1144/1144; biome clean; tsc baseline-only; tree clean (reverted test-boot dist + a stray `.design` viewport-meta churn).

decision.title: Execution Progress — Phase 13 (Canvas Activity Overlay)
decision.rationale:
Execution Progress — Phase 13 (Canvas Activity Overlay)

- Plan: .ai/plans/phase-13-canvas-activity-overlay.md (started + completed 2026-06-02)
- [x] Task 1 — `isCanvasFile` classifier ✅ (activity.ts; 6 unit tests)
- [x] Task 2 — `activity.ts` tracker module ✅ (fs:any → active|idle debounce, injectable idleMs; transition tests)
- [x] Task 3 — wire activity into server bootstrap + ws ✅ (createActivity in server.ts; `activity:change`→`broadcastHmr`; snapshot seeds `activity.state`)
- [x] Task 4 — `CanvasActivityProvider` + `useCanvasActivity` hook ✅ (use-canvas-activity.tsx; pure reducer + key-normalize tests)
- [x] Task 5 — `ArtboardActivityOverlay` + DCArtboard integration ✅ (overlay component + DCArtboard fragment + overlay render tests)
- [x] Task 6 — overlay CSS (inspector-style block) ✅ (inspect.ts: rim/badge/@keyframes/reduced-motion, html-scoped)
- [x] Task 7 — STRETCH per-artboard diff detection ✅ (diffArtboardIds regex-region diff; LRU stash; 6 tests)
- [x] Task 8 — `/design:edit` + `/design:new` docs note ✅ + hide-chrome export suppression of `.dc-activity-rim`
- [x] Task 9 — DDR filed ✅ as **DDR-075** (plan reserved "-029" but it was taken; cross-linked from plan)
- **Key fix during execution:** the provider had to move from `mountCanvas` (comment-mount.js bundle) into `DesignCanvas` (canvas-lib bundle) — separate bundles → separate React context instances; consumer never saw a provider in another bundle (same reason the real ToolProvider lives in DesignCanvas). Plus a window-stashed snapshot seed (`__maude_activity_seed__`) so the overlay survives the HMR module-reload a `.tsx` edit triggers (snapshot can arrive before React mounts).
- **Verified live (agent-browser, working-tree server):** idle=0 rims; `touch` a canvas → rim + badge "editing — Smoke TSX.tsx"; faded to 0 after 3s idle; multi-canvas scoping (touching Smoke TSX leaves Canvas Viewport dark); reduced-motion CSS served; no render regression. 1082 dev-server tests green; tsc clean (modulo 3 DDR-026 baseline); biome clean.
- **NOT mine — left untouched (user's concurrent work):** `plugins/design/dev-server/sync/agent.ts`, `test/sync-agent.test.ts`, `plugins/design/hub/src/admin/{app.js,index.html,style.css}` (hub wildcard-token-scope feature).

### Phase 13.1 — HMR error resilience during agent editing (DDR-077) ✅ 2026-06-02

User report: during a live `/design:edit` run, an agent's half-saved file (missing import / undefined symbol / transpile error) flashed the canvas to a **white screen** (hard `location.reload()` into a broken module). Asked to prevent it — **only while an agent is connected**.

- **Gate:** reuse the Phase 8 `ai-activity` signal in `_shell.html` (parent `dgn:'ai-activity'` postMessage relay when embedded + own inspector WS frame when standalone). `agentEditing` true ⇒ error-resilient path; false ⇒ unchanged `location.reload()` (manual editing keeps the white-screen "you broke it" signal).
- **Build/import error:** `import(canvasUrl + '?v=…')` rejects before any teardown → keep current render + amber "⏸ build error — držím poslední funkční verzi" toast; next good build's import swaps in via `window.__maudeCanvasRuntime.remount`.
- **Render-time throw:** resettable `CanvasErrorBoundary` (canvas-comment-mount.tsx) holds the last good render (`OkSignal` commit-effect only advances `lastGood` on a clean render) + same toast; new attempt clears + retries.
- **Files:** `canvas-comment-mount.tsx` (runtime + boundary + remount/hold API + `buildCanvasTree`), `templates/_shell.html` (agent gate + `softReload` + module/hard gating + hide-chrome suppress), `inspect.ts` (`.dc-hmr-holding` CSS), `test/canvas-hmr-runtime.test.tsx` (happy-dom boundary hold+recover), DDR-077, changeset.
- **Live-verified** (throwaway canvas + simulated agent via `/_api/ai/start`): build-error save → held render + toast (no white flash, screenshot captured); good save → soft swap + toast cleared; `/_api/ai/end` → gate false → plain reload restored. 1085 dev-server tests green; tsc baseline-only; biome clean.
- **Accepted residuals (in DDR-077):** sub-200 ms first-edit race (covered because `/design:edit` starts ai-activity before writing); ESM `?v=` module retention over a long session; per-swap canvas-state reset (same as a full reload).
- **NOTE:** Phase 13.1 code landed AFTER the `/flow:validate` run on the Phase 13 base — re-run `/flow:validate` (or let `/done` do it) so the full gate + a security pass cover the new WS-gate / dynamic-import / runtime-global surface.

### Phase 13.2 — agent presence (DDR-078) ✅ 2026-06-02

User ask: more agents working on canvases should feel like additional connected people — distinct colors, funny names, a presence avatar in the corner. Scope confirmed via AskUserQuestion: **one-per-canvas MVP** (no ai-activity multi-author refactor) · **avatar + overlay only** (no roaming cursor) · **subtle AI marker**.

- **Identity (no flow change):** derived client-side from the existing `ai-activity` entry — `${author}:${startedAt}` → deterministic funny name ("Adjective Animal", 20×20) + color via `colorForName` (the same palette human peers use). `startedAt` is stable across heartbeats → stable per-session identity.
- **`use-agent-presence.tsx` (new):** `AgentPresenceProvider` (mounted in `DesignCanvas`, canvas-lib bundle — same cross-bundle rule as DDR-077) subscribes to `ai-activity` like `ai-banner` (postMessage relay + own WS + `GET /_api/ai` seed); `useAgentPresence()` exposes the virtual peer.
- **`participants-chrome.tsx`:** renders an `AgentAvatar` (peer chip + ✦ marker + "AI agent · <author>" popover) alongside human peers; shows even with zero human peers.
- **`canvas-lib.tsx` (DCArtboard):** tints the activity overlay with `agent.color` + shows `agent.name` ("editing — Nimble Ferret") when an agent is the editor; `artboard-activity-overlay.tsx` takes an optional `color` (overrides `--mdcc-activity`).
- **Soft-reload compose fix:** `_shell.html` now keeps `window.__maude_activity_seed__` live-updated on every `activity` message (not just `snapshot`) so the overlay survives the 13.1 soft-reload remount (which skips the snapshot re-seed).
- **Live-verified:** ai-activity → colored avatar ("Sleepy Lynx" orange / "Nimble Ferret" blue) with ✦ marker + matching-color rim + "editing — <funny name>" badge (screenshots captured); survives soft-reload; non-agent manual edit unchanged (blue rim + file label, no avatar). `use-agent-presence.test.tsx` (9 tests); 1094 dev-server tests green; tsc baseline-only; biome clean.
- **Deferred:** multi-agent on the SAME file (ai-activity multi-author); roaming agent cursor; the pre-existing presence-peer-accumulation bug (agent avatars are virtual, don't worsen it).
- **NOTE:** 13.1 + 13.2 both landed after the Phase-13 `/flow:validate` — one re-run covers all three at `/done`.

### Phase 13.3 — full-artboard scan beam ✅ 2026-06-02

User ask: make the "editing pulse" a light overlay sweeping the whole artboard top→bottom (scan/edit feel), not just a rim glow.

- **`inspect.ts`:** replaced the rim `::after` opacity-pulse with a static glow + a new `.dc-activity-scan` cover whose `::after` is a soft gradient band animated `transform: translateY(-60%→60%)` (size-independent, transform-only). Inherits `--mdcc-activity` → scans in the agent's color (DDR-078). `prefers-reduced-motion` drops the beam (static rim remains). `--mdcc-activity-scan-ms` default 2200 ms.
- **`artboard-activity-overlay.tsx`:** mounts a `<div className="dc-activity-scan">` inside the rim (which is now `overflow:hidden` so the beam clips to the rounded artboard).
- **`workflows.config.json`:** `motion.customPulses.canvasActivity` 1200 → 2200 (the ambient-loop declaration, flow:motion-rules §9).
- Refinement note in DDR-075 (visual contract); changeset line added. `artboard-activity-overlay.test.tsx` asserts the scan element + the agent-color var override (5 tests). Live-verified: beam sweeps top→bottom in the agent color (frames at 6.0 s = band at top, 7.2 s = band at bottom); non-agent = blue beam. 1095 dev-server tests green; tsc baseline-only; biome clean. Runtime + injected-CSS only — no static dist change.
- **Tuned per user feedback (several rounds):** (1) "dost na sílu" → softened to base wash + blurred beam. (2) bottom-anchored wave — but its opacity breathe was imperceptible on video. (3) **Final:** the AGENT BORDER is the primary indicator — clear `2.5px` border in the agent color + a breathing glow (`::after`, opacity 0.4↔0.85, 2.2 s); the wave is now a **light STATIC bottom wash** (10%→0) behind it; label unchanged. Key fix: `overflow:hidden` was on the rim and **clipped the outward glow** (why the border was "skoro neni vidět") — moved clipping onto the child wash so the glow shows. (Also: a backtick inside an injected-CSS comment crashed boot — the whole INSPECTOR_SCRIPT is a template literal; comments there must avoid backticks.) reduced-motion → static glow. Inherits agent color (DDR-078).
- **Wave — final form (after ~5 iterations):** static 10% wash → imperceptible; opacity-breathe → imperceptible; in-place tide → "just bounces"; repeating-gradient flow → "looks like a beam again + starts mid-height". **Final:** ONE gradient — `.dc-activity-scan::after`, `linear-gradient(to top, --mdcc-activity 20% → transparent)` (sharp bottom edge, fade up), `height:135%` (taller-than-artboard so the wave is stretched + fuller per user "udělej ji vyšší"), animated `translateY(-100%→100%)` `linear` (~3.8 s). The sharp edge enters at the top, the whole wave sweeps straight down and off past the bottom, next enters from the top, loop. reduced-motion → `.dc-activity-scan { display:none }` (border's static glow remains).

decision.rationale:
Execution Progress — canvas-figjam-feel (Wave 3.5 post-review fixes, 2026-05-26)

User-side review of Wave 3 surfaced 7 grievances; all addressed:

- ✅ **G1** — Click-on-empty deselect re-enabled. Reverts Wave-2.7 fix #1: a bare click on empty world (annotations marquee path) now clears annotation selection; bare click on empty world outside any artboard (artboard-marquee path) clears element/artboard selection. Shift-click preserves selection for additive workflows. Esc remains as the secondary deselect gesture.
- ✅ **G2** — Dropped dblclick-on-artboard auto-zoom. T33's artboard zoom-to was too magnetic and conflicted with native dblclick text-select inside chrome. Kept dblclick-on-empty → `controller.fit()` (discoverable "back to overview"); artboard zoom remains reachable via Cmd+1 + zoom HUD.
- ✅ **G3** — ContextualToolbar Comment button now opens the composer. Old code only posted `dgn: 'comment-compose'` to the parent; the actual composer listens on the iframe-level `cm:open-composer` CustomEvent. Toolbar now dispatches that event with cursor coords derived from the selected element's bbox (right edge, vertical midpoint), so the composer lands beside the element rather than at viewport origin.
- ✅ **G4** — Comment composer position. `computeAnchor` in `comments-overlay.tsx` now prefers the cursor click point (composer drops 8 px below the cursor) over the element bottom-left anchor. The element-rect fallback survives for entry points without a cursor.
- ✅ **G5** — Annotation marquee no longer fires during artboard drag. The annotation-layer pointerdown handler now bails when pointerdown lands inside any `[data-dc-screen]` artboard without hitting an actual stroke — the artboard drag / element-marquee already own that gesture, so racing the annotation marquee against them was the source of the visual noise.
- ✅ **G6** — FigJam-style 11-color palette. Replaced the muddy 6-color stroke + 6-color fill palettes with a unified 11-color palette (black / gray / red / orange / yellow / green / teal / blue / purple / pink / white) used in both Stroke and Fill modes. Identical color identity across modes preserves the swatch row when the user flips the mode toggle.
- ✅ **G7** — Align commands. New `alignArtboards(mode)` in `canvas-shell.tsx` covers 6 modes (left / right / center-x / top / bottom / center-y). Enabled at ≥ 2 artboards (alignment well-defined). 6 new icon buttons added to `MultiArtboardToolbar` before the existing 2 distribute buttons, separated by a hairline divider. 6 new menu entries in the artboard-chrome context-menu registry as discoverability backup.

decision.rationale:
Execution Progress — canvas-figjam-feel (Wave 3.6 user-feedback batch, 2026-05-26)

User retested after Wave 3.5, found 4 remaining issues:

- ✅ **G2v2** — Dropped `controller.jumpTo` from artboard label button onClick. Single-click on artboard chrome no longer auto-zooms. `fit-one` context-menu entry rewired through new `focusArtboard(id)` callback (looks up rect from artboardsCtx and calls jumpTo directly).
- ✅ **G6v3** — Reverted Thick from 10 → 6 (user feedback: too thick). Thin stays at 3. Thickness controls hidden when swatchMode = 'fill' (already shipped in G6v2).
- ✅ **G3v3 + G7v3 root cause (single shared bug):** the G1 fix re-enabled "click-on-empty clears selection" via the doc-level marquee `pointerup`-without-crossed handlers. But the marquee chrome filters (`shouldIgnoreTarget` in `artboard-marquee.tsx`, `isChromeTarget` in `marquee-overlay.tsx`, `CHROME_SELECTOR` in `annotations-layer.tsx`) didn't list the floating toolbar surfaces. When the user clicked any button on `MultiArtboardToolbar` or `ContextualToolbar` or `EqualSpacingHandles`:
  1. `pointerdown` lands on the button — marquee handlers see it, target NOT recognized as chrome → enter pending state.
  2. User releases without dragging → `pointerup` fires.
  3. `s.crossed === false` → my G1 path runs `selSet.clear()` BEFORE the button's `onClick` (synchronous DOM event order, capture phase doc listener fires first).
  4. Button `onClick` then runs `distributeArtboards()` / `alignArtboards()` / `openComposerForSelection()` — closure reads the just-cleared selection → bails on `< 3` / `!primary` guard.

  **Fix:** added `.dc-multi-artboard-tb, .dc-elem-ctx-tb, .dc-cv-eq-spacing-layer` (plus the previously-missing `.cm-composer, .cm-thread, .cm-mention-popup, .cm-pin, .dc-annot-resize-handle` in annotations-layer) to all three chrome filters. Doc-level marquee bails when pointerdown lands on these surfaces, selection survives the click.

  **Live verified via agent-browser:** before fix — `pointerdown→pointerup→click` on Distribute H button leaves `haloCount: 0` (selection cleared). After fix — `haloCount: 3 → 3` (selection survives), distribute fires, artboard moves. G3 composer also renders at `(571, 79)`.

  **G1 still works:** clicking actual empty world (no artboard, no toolbar) → selSet cleared (`afterSelect: 2 → afterEmptyClick: 0` verified live).

**Bonus structural fix:** extended canvas-build mtime cache invalidation to watch the entire dev-server source tree (not just `_lib/canvas-lib.tsx`). Without this, edits to `canvas-shell.tsx`, `contextual-toolbar.tsx`, etc. don't surface to canvas iframes — the stale-bundle behaviour that masked half of G3/G7 debugging. Recursive `fs.watch` over `DEV_SERVER_ROOT`, filtered to `.tsx` (server-only `.ts` skipped — doesn't bundle into canvas), excluding `test/`, `dist/`, `client/`.

**Validation:**
- 409/409 bun tests green
- `bunx tsc --noEmit` clean (DDR-026 baseline only)
- agent-browser live tests on `localhost:4555` Canvas Viewport: G2v2 (no zoom on label click) + G3 (Comment composer renders) + G7 (selection survives toolbar button click + distribute moves artboards) + G1-regression-check (empty-world click still clears) all pass.

- ✅ Task 24 — Distribute artboards horizontally / vertically: gated on ≥ 3 selected artboards; menu items in `artboard-chrome` registry + `⌘⌥H` / `⌘⌥V` keybinds; reuses existing `dragBus.commitPositions` persistence channel. (Artboard marquee deferred to Wave 3 / T26 coupling.) (G8)
- ✅ Wave 2.7 (post-user-review batch, 2026-05-26) — three coordinated fixes from second feedback round:
  1. **No auto-clear on empty-space click.** `onSelect` no-target path, annotation-layer empty-world up-click, and `artboard-marquee` threshold-cross all stripped of their `selSet.clear()` / `annotSel.clear()` calls. Marquee with zero hits preserves existing selection. Esc remains the single deselect gesture across elements / artboards / annotations.
  2. **Direct artboard drag, no ghost.** Dropped `.dc-artboard-ghost` rendering + `.dc-dragging` opacity-0.3 fade. The `<article>` now updates its own inline `left/top` to `liveX/liveY` each frame while the drag is in flight; commit-on-settle path unchanged. Removed the `dc-dragging` halo / group-bbox hide guards added in the prior fix — they're unnecessary now that the halo follows the moving article via `getBoundingClientRect`.
  3. **Distribute floating toolbar + drop ⌘⌥H / ⌘⌥V keybinds.** New `MultiArtboardToolbar` mounted in `CanvasRouter`, anchored above the group-bbox top-center (flips below when top < 60 px from viewport edge). Renders when ≥ 2 artboards selected; Distribute H / V buttons enabled at ≥ 3 (math is undefined for 2). Floating chrome ambient shadow per DDR-046 (`0 6px 24px color-mix(--fg-0 10%, transparent)` + 8 px radius). Keybindy odstraněny per user feedback — toolbar je primární surface, kontext-menu zůstává jako discoverability backup.

- ✅ Task 24.6 (follow-up) — **Artboard marquee drag-to-lasso.** New `artboard-marquee.tsx` overlay mounted in `CanvasRouter`. Bare left-button pointerdown on empty world (no `[data-dc-screen]` ancestor, no floating chrome / overlay) in move tool starts a marquee. 4 px drag threshold suppresses click jitter (early portion of T25 Wave 3 logic landed locally to unblock T24). Bare-mode clears `selSet` up-front when threshold crosses (user sees "starting fresh"); Shift-mode preserves the set for add-to-selection. `pointermove` paints `.dc-cv-marquee` div (1 px solid accent + 8 % accent fill per DDR-046 rev 2 — solid not dashed; dashed reserved for persistent group bbox). `pointerup` intersects marquee AABB with every artboard's screen-coord `getBoundingClientRect()`; hits build `Selection` entries with `artboardId` set + `[data-dc-screen="…"]` selector. Shift → `selSet.add(hits)`, bare → `selSet.replace(hits)`. With T24.5 chrome-click selection + this marquee gesture, the distribute commands now have both single-shot (Cmd+Shift+Click) and lasso entry paths.

- ✅ Task 24.5 (follow-up) — **Artboard chrome selection gesture.** Opened `resolveHoverTarget`: clicks on artboard chrome (label, header, article root) OR empty body padding return the `<article>` element with `cdId=null` and `artboardId` populated. `hoverTargetToSelection` falls back to `[data-dc-screen="…"]` selector when there's no `cdId`. Existing SelectionHalos/GroupBbox find the article via that selector and paint around the whole frame (single-select → 2 px solid + 18 % ring + 8×8 corner ticks; multi-member → 1.5 px solid; group bbox → 1 px dashed + 6×6 corner ticks). Active-artboard ring (`aria-current="true"` → 2 px box-shadow on article) stays orthogonal to selection halo — both can fire (active = "where viewport is parked", selected = "what I'm operating on"). Drag suppression from prior patch (`dc-dragging` guard) keeps the halo + group bbox hidden during artboard drag. Multi-artboard distribute (T24) now has a real gesture path: Cmd+Shift+Click on artboard chrome accumulates `selSet` entries with `artboardId` set, and the gate `selectedArtboardCount >= 3` becomes reachable. The previous T24 menu items were UI without a way to enter the precondition — this patch closes that gap.

- ✅ Task 1: `plugins/design/dev-server/canvas-pipeline.ts` — two-pass transform via `oxc-parser` (parse) + `magic-string` (byte-range inject) + `Bun.Transpiler` (TSX→JS). ID = `Bun.hash(componentName + ":" + idx).toString(16).slice(0, 8)` — 8 hex chars, no `blake3-wasm` dep added (plan permitted Bun.hash). 15 bun:test cases green; covers determinism, whitespace-stability, sibling-insert contract, robustness (arrow components, JSXMemberExpression, idempotency on re-transpile of post-pass-1 source, malformed source → TranspileError).
- ✅ Task 2: `plugins/design/dev-server/locator.ts` — per-canvas `_locator.json` writer with per-path Promise-mutex + atomic rename. Top-level keyed by canvas slug (POSIX, ext-less, relative to designRoot). 14 bun:test cases green; covers roundtrip, multi-slug isolation, deterministic sorted-key JSON, 20-way concurrent multi-slug writes, 10-way concurrent same-slug last-writer-wins, clearLocatorSlug, malformed-JSON-as-empty.
- ✅ Task 3: `plugins/design/dev-server/http.ts` — TSX-route hooked into the existing fall-through `fetch()`. URL pattern `/.design/ui/<file>.tsx` (matches existing shell `urlOf()` helper that prefixes designRel into the iframe src). 200 + `application/javascript` + ETag (`Bun.hash(post-pass-1 source).toString(16)`); 304 on `If-None-Match` match; 500 + readable body on `TranspileError`; 404 / 403 on missing / traversal. In-memory `(absPath -> { mtimeMs, etag, js })` cache skips re-transpile when source unchanged. Locator is written synchronously before the response. 7 bun:test cases green.

decision.rationale: phase-9-self-hosted-hub-file-sync — partial-ship: **Slice: Task 5 — awareness layer on hub (awareness over WSS) on top of `57cd33b` (Task 4 + DDR-054 hardening).** In linked mode each canvas has two in-process Awareness instances: the collab Room's (browser tabs ↔ dev-server, Phase 8 loopback WS) and the sync provider's (dev-server ↔ hub, HocuspocusProvider). Hocuspocus relays awareness between document peers by default, so the only missing link was in-process. **New `collab/awareness-bridge.ts`** `bridgeAwareness(a, b): () => void` — bidirectional relay with a single shared `BRIDGE` origin (each direction skips updates carrying it → no echo storm) + initial-state exchange at wire time; state identity preserved by relaying per-clientID (standard y-websocket fan-out pattern). **`collab/registry.ts`** owns the bridge lifecycle (rooms churn as tabs open/close; providers persist server-lifetime): new `attachHubAwareness(slug, awareness)` stores the hub Awareness per slug, wires on room `get()`, tears down in `drop()`/`destroyAll()` BEFORE `room.destroy()` runs `awareness.destroy()` (a late relay must not hit a dead instance), and auto-re-wires on room churn (hub awareness persists across a browser disconnect/reconnect). **`sync/index.ts`** — `SyncProvider` gains optional `awareness`; default factory returns the HocuspocusProvider's `.awareness`; runtime accepts a structural `AwarenessRegistry` (no module cycle), attaches each provider's awareness on `start()`, detaches on `stop()`. **`server.ts`** passes `collab.registry` to `createSyncRuntime`. **No hub-side change.** **F14 decision (DDR-054 flagged it blocking-before-Task-5-code):** awareness is ephemeral → the bridge writes NO files → it neither introduces nor resolves the comments/annotations file-ownership race. The doc-content bridge (Room doc ↔ provider doc) is intentionally NOT built; disk stays the medium between the two docs (Task 4) and F14 remains a documented risk for the doc-content bridge work (Task 6/8). **Solo mode is a provable no-op:** `createSyncRuntime` returns null unlinked + `wireBridge` early-returns when no hub awareness is attached (always, in solo) — rendering path untouched. **Verification:** 645/645 dev-server tests (+13 net: `test/collab-awareness-bridge.test.ts` 12 — bridge relay/echo/removal/initial-exchange/detach + registry attach-then-create/create-then-attach/detach-prevents-rewire/room-churn-rewire/destroyAll + end-to-end cross-peer relay Room A → simulated hub → Room B; `sync-runtime.test.ts` +1 attach-each-canvas/detach-on-stop). tsc clean modulo api.ts:899 + runtime-bundle.ts:333 baseline (DDR-026); biome clean across 6 touched files (one type-only-import split in awareness-bridge.ts). decision.title: 2026-05-27 · phase-9-self-hosted-hub-file-sync · hardening-pass
decision.rationale: phase-9-self-hosted-hub-file-sync — hardening-pass: **DDR-053 hardening pass on top of the Task 2.5 initial slice (still pre-commit).** `/flow:validate` surfaced 12 security blockers + 8 a11y blockers via security-auditor + ethical-hacker + a11y-auditor agents (both attacker chains promoted HIGH). User chose "fix everything before commit" + DDR. **DDR-053 written** (`.ai/archive/decisions/DDR-053-hub-admin-auth-architecture.md`) pinning: Bearer-only admin auth, atomic single-use bootstrap (rename-to-consume), no-reissue post-consume, scope-bound tokens (`scope = label` default; `documentName` must match), session-kick on rotate, CSP + XFO + Referrer-Policy on `/admin*`, per-IP rate limit (5/60s), strict `Content-Type: application/json` on POSTs, proto-pollution + body-timeout guards, sanitizeForLog on every interpolated log value. **Implementation:** `src/{server,admin-auth,bootstrap,tokens}.mjs` rewritten to DDR contract; `src/admin/{index.html,style.css,app.js}` got the a11y batch (role=alert on errors, aria-labelledby on dialog, dialog focus mgmt + restore, aria-live "Command copied" feedback, --muted darkened #78716c → #57534e for contrast, aria-hidden on decorative icons, skip-nav link, table captions + scope=col, .sr-only + .skip-nav utilities, explicit label for= pairing). **Tests:** 3 new files (`scope.test.mjs` 10 cases, `admin-hardening.test.mjs` 21 cases, `rate-limit.test.mjs` 3 cases) + 4 existing files updated for the new DDR contract (?secret rejected, bootstrap.used.json marker, no-reissue policy). **Verification:** 85/85 hub-side tests + 112/112 across phase-9 surface combined with cli tests. Release bundle **176 KB** (was 172; +4 KB); admin assets **18 KB raw / 6.4 KB gz** (≤ 15 KB ceiling, 60% headroom). Biome lint clean across 18 files. End-to-end smoke against bundled `dist/hub.bundle.mjs` confirms: bootstrap URL printed, consume returns admin secret, admin secret authorizes API, invite mint returns copy-paste command, bootstrap-key replay returns 401, `?secret=` query rejected 401, POST without JSON Content-Type rejected 400. **Three implementation gotchas:** (1) biome `noControlCharactersInRegex` blocked the obvious `[\r\n\t\x00-\x1f]` sanitizer regex — switched to charCode loop for the same semantics. (2) Rate-limit initial pass consumed budget on 401s but didn't enforce 429 — fix: 401 path now early-returns 429 when limit exceeded. (3) Port collisions across hub-test files required range stratification: 14598-14699 (admin-api), 14700+ (admin-hardening), 14800+ (rate-limit) — design-link.test.mjs already on 14396. **Files this hardening pass (7 new + 8 modified):** see plan §Task 2.5 §Shipped DDR-053 bullet for the file-by-file breakdown. Re-running security + a11y auditor agents to confirm 0 blockers remain. Awaiting their verdict + commit. |

decision.title: 2026-05-27 · phase-9-self-hosted-hub-file-sync · partial-ship
decision.rationale: phase-9-self-hosted-hub-file-sync — partial-ship: **Slice: Task 3 — peer pairing CLI (`maude design link\|unlink\|status\|adopt`) on top of `31e5e3e` (Task 2).** All four subcommands shipped end-to-end against a working hub: `link <url> --token <hex> [--adopt] [--force]` pings `/health` + writes `.design/config.json.linkedHub` (committed) + `~/.config/maude/hubs.json` token (per-machine, gitignored convention); `adopt` is an alias of `link --adopt` for discoverability; `unlink [--keep-token]` drops both; `status [--json]` reads linkedHub + probes hub liveness. **URL normalization** (`cli/lib/hubs-config.mjs` `normalizeUrl`): lowercases scheme + host, strips trailing slash — `https://Hub.example.com/` and `https://hub.example.com` resolve to the same token-store key. **Per-user store path** = `$HUBS_CONFIG_PATH` (test override) → `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/maude/hubs.json` → `~/.config/maude/hubs.json`. File mode 0600; parent dir created on first write. Plan text said `~/.config/mdcc/hubs.json` from before the v0.15.0 rename — shipped at the new path. **Refactored** `cli/commands/design.mjs` to import + dispatch four new subcommands from `cli/lib/design-link.mjs`; `usage()` extended. **Token NEVER lands in committed `.design/config.json`** — only the URL + linkedAt + optional `adopt: true` flag. Tokens live per-machine. **Verification:** 27/27 cli tests via `node --test` (9 hubs-config unit + 7 hub CLI + 11 design-link e2e) + 15/15 hub-side tests still green = **42/42 total across phase-9 surfaces**. **Three runtime gotchas discovered + worked around in the test harness:**  (1) `spawnSync` blocks the parent's event loop; an in-process mock /health server cannot respond to a spawned child's `fetch` because the parent is locked. Switched to async `child_process.spawn` + Promise resolution on `exit`. (2) Hocuspocus' crossws adapter holds the event loop open via FD references such that subsequent spawnSync calls hang — this is the same class of bug as (1), so the same async-spawn fix applies, BUT (3) we sidestepped Hocuspocus entirely in `design-link.test.mjs` by mocking `/health` via plain `node:http` — way simpler, way faster (full file 741 ms). Production runtime is unaffected; only the test harness pattern matters. **Files (3 new + 2 modified):** `cli/lib/hubs-config.mjs` (new), `cli/lib/hubs-config.test.mjs` (new), `cli/lib/design-link.mjs` (new), `cli/commands/design-link.test.mjs` (new), `cli/commands/design.mjs` (M — dispatch + usage), `.ai/state/STATE.md` (this row), `.ai/plans/phase-9-self-hosted-hub-file-sync.md` (Task 3 ✅). **Up next (phase-9):** Task 2.5 (in-hub admin UI), Task 4 (bidirectional file sync agent — the hard part — Yjs↔fs.watch + SHA-256 echo prevention + atomic writes). Awaiting commit. |

decision.title: 2026-05-27 · phase-9-self-hosted-hub-file-sync · partial-ship
decision.rationale: phase-9-self-hosted-hub-file-sync — partial-ship: **Slice: Task 2 (minimal subset) on top of `41d9ad9` (Task 0+1) + `24e07f3` (parallel phase-a slice that absorbed the cli/bin + cli/commands/help dispatcher additions for the `hub` subcommand into its commit).** Shipped: `maude hub serve` + `maude hub token generate` + `maude hub status` (deferred: `maude hub deploy fly\|docker`, `maude hub token rotate` — they land with Task 7's Dockerfile/fly.toml work). **Server-side** (`plugins/design/hub/src/server.mjs`): replaced Task 1 single-secret auth stub with tokens.json-primary + HUB_SECRET-fallback + dev-mode-on-empty. Added `onRequest` hook serving `GET /health` → JSON `{ ok, version, uptimeMs, port, dataDir, tokenCount, authMode }`. Hocuspocus dispatcher quirk discovered: `throw null` is the documented bail-from-onRequest contract (`if (error) throw error;` in the framework's requestHandler swallows falsy throws, suppressing the default `200 Welcome to Hocuspocus!` writer). Without this, `ERR_HTTP_HEADERS_SENT` rejections leak as unhandledRejection events between tests. **Token module** (`plugins/design/hub/src/tokens.mjs`): `addToken({ label, dev })` writes `<dataDir>/tokens.json` with mode 0600, label-idempotent (rotation shape — same label overwrites in place); `verifyToken` uses `timingSafeEqual` for constant-time comparison, checks file entries first then HUB_SECRET fallback. Plaintext storage with file mode 0600 is Task 2 floor — Phase 9 Task 6 hardens to HMAC-SHA256 in SQLite. **CLI** (`cli/commands/hub.mjs`): three subcommands matching the plan; `serve` spawns either bundled `dist/hub.bundle.mjs` or `src/server.mjs` based on what's on disk; `--dev` mode mints a `mau_dev_<hex>` token + prints the connect command before booting; `status` accepts `ws://`/`wss://` URLs (rewrites to `http://`/`https://`) and parses `--json` vs human-readable table. **Wiring into CLI dispatcher** (cli/bin/maude.mjs + cli/commands/help.mjs `hub` block) was absorbed by the phase-a commit `24e07f3`; no separate diff this slice. **Verification:** 7/7 cli tests (`cli/commands/hub.test.mjs`) + 11/11 tokens tests + 3/3 health tests + 1/1 two-client-sync (unchanged from Task 1) — total 22/22 green via `node --test --test-force-exit`. End-to-end smoke: `maude hub token generate --label alice --data $TMP` → token + connect command printed + JSON written; `maude hub status http://localhost:14395` → uptime + version + token-count table; `--json` flag → raw payload. Bundle 336 KB (from 333 KB — `+3 KB` for tokens.mjs + /health). **Files (1 modified + 5 new):** `plugins/design/hub/src/server.mjs` (M), `plugins/design/hub/src/tokens.mjs` (new), `plugins/design/hub/test/health.test.mjs` (new), `plugins/design/hub/test/tokens.test.mjs` (new), `cli/commands/hub.mjs` (new), `cli/commands/hub.test.mjs` (new). **NOT shipped this slice:** Task 2 deploy targets (`fly`, `docker`), Task 2 `token rotate`. **Up next (phase-9):** Task 2.5 (in-hub admin UI), Task 3 (`maude design link\|unlink\|status\|adopt`), Task 4 (bidirectional file sync agent — the hard part). Awaiting commit; no `/done` (parent phase-9 plan still open). |

decision.rationale: phase-9-self-hosted-hub-file-sync — partial-ship: **Slice: Task 0 + Task 1 only** (user-confirmed scope cut against full 11-task plan; Tasks 2–11 to follow as separate phases / sessions). **Task 0 — DDR-052** written at `.ai/archive/decisions/DDR-052-hocuspocus-over-partykit-for-hub.md`: Hocuspocus chosen over PartyKit (Cloudflare/Workers coupling), y-websocket (forked "starter code"), custom (unnecessary reinvention), TipTap Collab (SaaS rejected). Six-constraint table + five independent decisive reasons + risk mitigation (TipTap commercial paywall hedged via lockfile pin + y-websocket fallback). **Task 1 — `@maude/hub` workspace promoted from pre-reserved stub to working Hocuspocus skeleton**: `plugins/design/hub/package.json` (deps `@hocuspocus/server@^4.1`, `@hocuspocus/extension-sqlite@^4.1`, `better-sqlite3@^12.10`, `yjs@^13.6`; devDep `@hocuspocus/provider@^4.1`), `src/server.mjs` (factory `createHub({ port, dataDir, secret, verbose }) → { server, sqlitePath, port, secret }` + `runAsMain()` invoked via `import.meta.url === file://${argv[1]}` guard; SQLite extension at `$DATA_DIR/hub.db`; `onAuthenticate` exact-match against `HUB_SECRET` or accept-and-warn if unset; SIGINT/SIGTERM graceful shutdown), `build.ts` (Bun-native bundle → `dist/hub.bundle.mjs` with `better-sqlite3`/`bun:sqlite`/`node:sqlite` external; 5 MB budget enforced), `test/two-client-sync.test.mjs` (`node --test --test-force-exit`; two `HocuspocusProvider` clients converge on `Y.Text` mutation in ~50 ms), `.gitignore`, refreshed `README.md`. **Runtime boundary discovered:** hub is **Node-only at runtime** — Hocuspocus' `crossws` adapter explicitly rejects Bun/Deno (`[crossws] Using Node.js adapter in an incompatible environment`) and `better-sqlite3` isn't Bun-compatible (Bun#4290). Tests therefore use `node --test`, not `bun:test`; `bun build` for bundling stays (it never runs the code). **Workspace config:** added `better-sqlite3: true` to `pnpm-workspace.yaml` `allowBuilds` (native C++ binding compiles on install). **Verification:** `pnpm --filter @maude/hub test` 1/1 pass (54 ms convergence); `pnpm --filter @maude/hub build` → 333 KB bundle (5 MB ceiling); `node dist/hub.bundle.mjs` boots, listens on `ws://0.0.0.0:$PORT`, logs `[hub] Maude Hub listening`, SIGTERM shuts down cleanly; dev-server tsc baseline (api.ts + runtime-bundle.ts errors per DDR-026) unchanged. **Files touched (8):** `.ai/archive/decisions/DDR-052-hocuspocus-over-partykit-for-hub.md` (new), `plugins/design/hub/package.json`, `plugins/design/hub/src/server.mjs` (new), `plugins/design/hub/build.ts` (new), `plugins/design/hub/test/two-client-sync.test.mjs` (new), `plugins/design/hub/.gitignore` (new), `plugins/design/hub/README.md`, `pnpm-workspace.yaml`, `pnpm-lock.yaml`. **NOT shipped this slice:** Tasks 2 (CLI `maude hub serve\|deploy\|token`), 2.5 (in-hub admin UI), 3 (`maude design link/unlink/status/adopt`), 4 (bidirectional file sync agent), 5 (awareness over WSS), 6 (auth hardening — HMAC + rate limit), 7 (Dockerfile + fly.toml + Caddyfile + docker-compose templates), 8 (conflict UX + hub-down offline mode), 9 (gitignore strategy DDR), 10 (contributor dev workflow doc), 11 (stress + integration test matrix). Phase-9 main plan retains 11 tasks; this slice closes Task 0 + Task 1 only. Awaiting commit; no `/done` from this slice (parent plan still open). |

decision.rationale: phase-8-live-collaboration-yjs-lan — done: All 9 tasks shipped across 4 feature commits + 4 follow-up fix commits after user-feedback testing. **Stack on `main`:** `9efd1b7` (Tasks 0–1 Yjs foundation + loopback collab WS) → `b0cf7be` (Tasks 2–3 cursor awareness + comments→Y.Array) → `acac75d` (Tasks 4–6 AI banner + annotations + participant chrome) → `a6ed8bd` (Tasks 7–8 git-lifecycle + stress) → `5f91151` (slug mismatch fix + foreign selection halo + meta HMR + Maude tokens) → `580b7f8` (annotation observe bail fix) → `f5f7fb8` (annotation-selection halos) → `6bc77a2` (annotSel scope fix). **Acceptance:** 11/13 met; AI banner needs in-browser sign-off; 5 collab scenarios deferred (need `agent-browser` two-context harness — captured as follow-up in plan retro). 530/530 bun tests green (+47 net new). tsc clean modulo pre-existing baseline. /design:smoke 42/42 ✓. decision.title: 2026-05-27 · phase-8-live-collaboration-yjs-lan · partial-ship
decision.rationale: phase-8-live-collaboration-yjs-lan — partial-ship: Tasks 7 + 8 complete on top of `acac75d`. **Task 7 (git-lifecycle reconciliation):** new `collab/git-lifecycle.ts` watches `.git/HEAD` via `fs.watch` with 250 ms debounce. On detected HEAD change (`git checkout`, `git pull`), the watcher SYNCHRONOUSLY calls `registry.flushAll()` to write every dirty Y.Doc → JSON BEFORE broadcasting `git-lifecycle` bus event. `ws.ts` relays to inspector clients; `client/app.jsx` forwards to all open iframes via postMessage AND renders a blue "Repo state changed — reload to sync?" pill with Reload + Dismiss buttons. Reload click → `location.reload()` → Y.Doc re-seeds from the post-checkout JSON. DDR-051 §3 no-data-loss invariant: in-flight edits inside the 800 ms debounce window are flushed to disk BEFORE the user's reload choice. decision.title: 2026-05-25 · fix-binary-oxc-parser-binding (every v0.17.x binary crashed) · done
decision.rationale: fix-binary-oxc-parser-binding (every v0.17.x binary crashed) — done: Bun 1.3.4 regressed `bun build --compile` NAPI native-binding embedding — every `@1agh/maude-<slug>` binary published since v0.17.0 crashed at `oxc-parser/src-js/bindings.js:575` on startup. 30-min spike bisected 1.3.3 last-good vs 1.3.4 first-bad and verified an env-var-based loader bypass (`NAPI_RS_NATIVE_LIBRARY_PATH` from a `with { type: 'file' }` asset import) works on 1.3.14. Fix is build-layer only: `build.ts:writeCompileEntry(target)` generates two thin files per `--target` (`init-oxc-<slug>.ts` leaf module + `server-<slug>.ts` entry) under `dist/.compile-entries/` and points `bun build --compile` at the generated entry instead of `server.ts`. Init module MUST be a separate file imported BEFORE server.ts — ESM hoists `import` statements above top-level code, so single-file pattern crashes (first generator pass had this bug, caught in T3 first smoke; T5 test asserts `initIdx < serverIdx` so the class is gated). All 7 `@oxc-parser/binding-<slug>` packages added as direct devDeps of `plugins/design/dev-server/` (pnpm otherwise hides them as transitive optionals inside oxc-parser's nested node_modules). Maude-slug→oxc-slug mapping mirrored in `oxcBindingSlug()` + the regression test: Linux gets `-gnu` libc suffix, Windows gets `-msvc` toolchain suffix, others unchanged. Zero edits to `canvas-pipeline.ts` / `canvas-edit.ts` / `canvas-lib-inline.ts` / `handoff.ts` — pipeline files don't know the workaround exists. Verified end-to-end: host binary on Bun 1.3.3 + 1.3.14 starts, `/_health` returns ok, banner prints. Cross-compiled 5 non-host targets (linux-x64 / linux-arm64 / linux-x64-musl / linux-arm64-musl / win32-x64) — all produce binaries with correct executable headers (`file` reports ELF + PE32+). `bun test` 340/340 across 42 files (+6 over 334 baseline). DDR-042 records the spike, options matrix (parser-swap rejected, subprocess rejected, external+ship rejected, version-pin rejected), env-var pattern, ESM hoisting trap, distribution constraint. Upstream Bun issue draft at `.ai/dev-logs/upstream-bun-issue-draft.md` for user to file. Changeset `fix-bun-compile-napi-embedding` patch authored. Plan archived. Retro appended: spike was the right detour (saved 1-2 days of wrong babel migration); first-cut generator put env-var in top-level code (ESM hoisting bug), caught at T3 smoke. |

Four bugs surfaced + fixed during validation + post-merge dogfooding: (1) reader was wholesale-overriding default-grid entries → 0×0 artboards when meta went position-only (fixed by merging defaults + meta); (2) `setPointerCapture` on outer article redirected the synthetic `click` target → pan-to-focus regression (fixed by dropping capture, global window listeners carry the drag); (3) `selectedIds` falling back from `Selection.id` (child cd-id) to `artboardId` silently disabled multi-drag (fixed via `selectionsToArtboardIds` helper + regression test); (4) `artboards` was `useMemo([seeds])` reading meta once at mount → drop committed to server but local state stayed frozen, user had to switch canvases to see the move (fixed by converting to `useState` + optimistic `setArtboards` on commit + `useEffect` re-seed on JSX changes, commit `1bd6acc`).
